This is a nice little concealer. I used it on some scars as well as skin blemishes and it worked alright for the most part. It was true to skin color. It covered the skin blemishes beautifully but not the scars. I had no issues blending it as long as you blend it right away and it look good after you were done. I would not use it as an eye shadow primer however because of its properties.

This pen basically is used to "fill in" larger pores with one end and the other end (black felt tip of sorts) helps smoothen it all out. The "pink" end is their primer that basically fills in whatever you want to cover up.

This "primer" has no scent to it and is very soft and almost melts into your skin.  It has about light to medium coverage.

I really like this lip scrub. It tastes deliciously of peach and is nice and gentle. Let's face it you don't want something that is too harsh on your lips and scrub the heck out of them. You want something nice and smooth that gently scrubs away the excess skin that is oh so annoying and tempts you into biting it off.

This scrub has Vitamin E, jojoba and coconut oil and some other nice ingredients and as I said tastes deliciously of peach. I personally am a huge fan of peach and this tastes 100% of peach and doesn't have a weird artificial flavor which is great. Thanks to the oils in this scrub your lips feel great after your wipe of the scrub.

This is a very nice, well made scrunchie, but what I do not understand is, why one scrunchie is $17? I have gotten a 52 pack for $8 before and they are all very nice scrunchies. Yes I understand that the silk does not damage the hair and therefore doesn't cause split ends, but at this price it better blow dry my hair for me while I am still sleeping.

It is beautiful, the color is a very nice deep emerald green, it is very well made, the silk has no pulled threads or anything, but I don't think I would be willing to spend that kind of money on just one. If this was a 5 pack or so I would be ok with it even for silk.
My wife loves this. Hoping to get another one soon.....

As a licensed professional I do not recommend this product. My spa owner purchased this from Amazon, when I went to try it on a PAYING CLIENT,  the glue did absolutely nothing. If the glue doesn't work then the service cannot proceed. I have done this service on many clients with a different brand and had success. This product not at all.
Not hand friendly but get the job done
Absolutely my FAVORITE!
It has a bad taste

I am willing to pay a few dollars extra for these razors. I've bought cheaper razors but they cut me and get dull and get rusty very fast. The Dorco brand has protective barriers on the razor so you won't cut yourself.  They work for a long time and do not rust!  My first set last 4 years before I had to replace them.  I recommend only buying DORCO.

Defective product. The strap was too small for my head but replacing it is not possible without ripping the hair out. The attachment on one side was in the hair on the front instead of the back of the head. So it would not work even if the stap did fit unless you folded it.  In addition, some of the hair was already falling out. I added a picture of the side which was not defective. I have it two stars but the color matched my hair exactly.
i bought for structure gel and builder gel.  I am happy with the brushes.
I’m pleasantly surprised, it’s a nice headband wig. I thought it was going to look like plastic, but it doesn’t it’s a nice texture. This is great for the price! Throw on an go!
I'm very happy with this product! Beautiful design and high quality results
Useless. To small to use for pin curls.
Love this matt lip color!
Great customer service, and super cool diffuser!

I used it in 5 different parts of my body, and hair grew back immediately on my legs (the most noticeable body part), even after multiple uses weekly.  I followed the instructions exactly, and did not receive the results I wanted.  Overall,  with the price I paid and how it didn't work, I would not recommend this to others.
This plant mister is perfect. I bought it it use on my air plants. It sprays a very fine mist and my plants are doing great!

I love a peppermint scent, and I love when there are those oils to make your skin feel refreshed.  I thought that might be the case on your scalp with this shampoo, but it didn't.  I like the mix of peppermint and lavendar, and I think it worked just fine.  Overall, it works as well as any other shampoo.

I've recently started doing my own "dip powder" nails, which lasts SO much longer than gel.  Plus, I don't have to worry about getting a fungus from the salon.  They can be pretty tough to take off, so you HAVE TO have Acetone to get them off.  I can use this stuff on a little cotton ball, wrap my nail and cotton in tinfoil, and let them soak for a bit.  This does the trick and quickly brings the polish/powder off.  In short, it does what it's supposed to do.

These are impossible to use! Once each eyelash is connected to the applicator, then they won't connect to each other because the magnetic in the applicator is stronger! And forget trying to manually apply. Picture trying to balance one eyelash on your eyelashes while attaching another from the bottom! The top eyelash will jump off to connect to the other one before you can even get it close! Don't waste your money.

I had this item sitting in my cart for a long time. I finally placed my order because the kit would basically pay for itself after one use. I was very impressed with everything. The colors are beautiful and last. Will definitely be ordering more colors! So happy with my purchase and my only regret is not buying it sooner!
So good...and I'm picky.
So Cheap! They Melt & Snap Apart as Soon as The Body Heat From Your Scalp Touches It!

I highly recommend getting a bears straightener and this one in particular.
If you have never used one, they work miracles. My beard hair is curly and seems to have a mind of its own. After using this the hair is much straiter and easier to style and manage. It also helps my beard to appear thicker and fuller.
The device is extremely well built and comes with many accessories for your beard needs.
Works great. Strong hold, odor isn't my favorite. Only need to use a little to go a long way.
This is probably the worst fiber lash mascara I have ever used! It just clumped all my eyelashes together! I just looked like I have clumps for eyelashes! Not good at all!
This product is AMAZING!!! It is so much healthier for your nails than dip and so much easier to file down. It does take a little getting used to but overall amazing!!!

I absolutely love the colors in this set! This is a perfect holiday color palette and I will definitely use this for Christmas! I also love that it come with a brush for excess powder. This is a very convenient color kit.

I do find these hair clips quite sturdy!  I have been using them to hold a pony tail. But not as strong to hold a ponytail on securely.  The teeth are very small,  and there is no grip of the hair.  The clip will fall.

Many years ago,  I had a ton of hair and now,  sadly,  it has thinned out.  I now can use hair clips to hold the entire hair.  I like that the clips look simple,  they are not bulky and fit easily on my hair.  I usually use one  and/or two on the pony tail.  I can wear this clip on my hair in public and it is not very visible.  I am getting a lot of use right now.  I like the clips!  The Clips will hold a ponytail,  but eventually will slide.  Just use it for holding the hair back in place.

This Norelco shaving system is just that, a system!  That's what one pays for because the closeness of the razor is not near what the hand held manual razor can do.  We have used this, face for hubby, legs for me, and bottom line is the shave is not as close.

There are great perks here!  The multi-purpose display is excellent, indicates how much time you have left before recharging and the time is plenty!  The storage case and charging stand are neat features.  But for the quick shave, you need to use it too long, going over and over!  It sure looks good though!  ...Rizzo

Husband grew a beard the moment he was put on blood thinners, and he has it trimmed once a month, but sometimes that's not enough. When it gets too long he tends to look like Grizzly Adams. I would keep it tamed with scissor trims, but this works much better; he can do the trim himself, and also trim his cheeks and mustache. We haven't tried it on trimming the hair at the back of his neck.

He does not like that it is only USB and you have to buy a wall plug adapter to charge it. I guess they figure most people have them now, but it should come with one. That's just being cheap.

They aren't your typical shower caps. I thought I was getting a deal but they are so cheap I can barely use them twice. They are sealed together on either side so if you don't open them carefully you can rip them. They also don't stretch very much so it's not for long hair.
Don't waste your money.

I hate this stuff. It is like clown makeup. Only Cole cream will take it off. It will clog your pores and make you break out. Only use if you really need full coverage. It would be better to head to ultra and just get a shade darker than you normally use for powder. Just avoid powders with Zinc….zinc turns white in stage lighting.
So cute! My 7 year old has loved playing with them. And best of all, they wash right out!! Love it!

They are so heavy and gorgeous that I hate to give them such a low review. The ornate heads are beautiful. They are so sturdy and are a great length for a low bun. However. The textured design that comes from the head and down the stick on some of them rip at my hair making it difficult to get them in and out of a tight bun.

I was skeptical because of the price and I've always used Neutrogena wipes and they have always worked great. But these were so much cheaper with good reviews that I thought I would give them a try and I love them! They take the makeup off (eyeliner, mascara, foundation, lipstick - all of it) and leaves my face feeling softer and more moisturized than any other wipes I've used.
Works excellent a lot of power only downside is the base not heavy enough what's the tip over as the water gets lower I still give it 5 stars for effectiveness
I love ordering my hair from Amazon and this was great hair!
This has worked pretty well for me over the past couple weeks of use, but I can’t say it’s worked better than products that cost half the price. It’s a good moisturizer, but it’s overpriced.

Though a bit pricey at $20 for 3.4 ounces, this face scrub does deliver solid results. It smells great, very fresh and masculine. It thoroughly exfoliates my skin and leaves it feeling soft, clean, smooth and moisturized. I've found that it's great to use before shaving, as it preps the skin by smoothing and moisturizing it.

Never heard of this brand but it was definitely the packaging that caught my attention. The saying "never judge a book by its cover" does NOT apply in this CASE. PLEASE try out this mascara. My lashes looked significantly longer and thicker with out any flakes or clumps. A very long lasting mascara  for a relatively decent price. Also, considering how long lasting it wore, the removal was insanely easy. I love this mascara!
This is a very decent palette for the price. I like the shades offered, and they are of good quality.

This is a very unique and effective product.

Used with a light pre-styler on medium-length hair:

Scent: It's a light scent. Warm and slightly spiced. Very pleasant and masculine.
Consistency: Extremely creamy. Becomes slightly tacky when emulsifying.
Styling: Smooth through the hair at first, with increasing tug the more you style. This is not a problem for me and is part of getting great hold from a product.
Finish: Slightly shiny at first, but becomes much more matte as it dries in the hair.
Hold: Legitimate all-day hold without becoming too rigid to restyle.

This is one of my new favorites. Seriously good in all areas, which is so rare. TheSalonGuy has a real winner with this one.

I really like this moisturizer. The consistency is extremely soft and smooth, and it feels incredible on my skin. It moisturizes wonderfully and feels like it actually fortifies the skin, making it feel thicker and stronger. The scent is very fresh and it absorbs well. I am already noticing (after a few days) a slight lightening of the skin under my eyes, which is exciting. A bit pricey, but definitely high quality.
These bottles are very good quality. All in perfect working order. They’re a great buy for the price.
Pricey, but it’s a high quality scrub. Great texture and exfoliation.

Aside from being a tad overpriced for a daily face wash, this stuff is great. It smells like cucumber - clean and fresh, it has the consistency of aloe vera gel but a bit thicker. The lather is low-foam. It feels great on my skin, and leaves it feeling soft and moisturized. Definitely a high quality product.

Applying to medium length hair with a light prestyler.

Scent: Very spicy. Christmas spices.
Texture: Waxy clay. Very thick.
Application: Thick and a bit tough to emulsify in the hands. A bit sticky during application.
Styling: Pretty responsive, but you have to work quickly.
Finish: Very high hold. Fairly low shine, but not matte.
This is a great product. The hold is strong, the finish is truly matte, and the price is a lot better than comparable clays, waxes and fibers. It has a light, masculine scent.

This is definitely a "cooling" body wash. It makes my skin tingle and would be excellent in the summer months when you need to bring your body temperature down. The scent is like menthol-eucalyptus, but a bit sweeter. The lather is very thick and smooth, and it rinses away leaving my skin feeling cool and moisturized. The only reason for the 4-star rating is the price. $15 is a bit much for 6 ounces of product.

I love the combination of this shampoo and conditioner. Both smell like sweet coconut.
The shampoo has a thick and luxurious lather and definitely feels like it adds volume to my hair.
The conditioner is thick, but light, a bit like a body butter. It softens my hair and leaves it extremely soft and silky.
The only reason I can't give these products five stars is because I think they're a bit overpriced. Yes, they create great results, but so do a lot of comparable brands that are less than half the price.

This shampoo smells great. The scent is very natural, but unfortunately it's not. Rather than using the pricier essential oils of peppermint and lavender, the company uses synthesized fragrance. The lather is decent and washes your hair about as well as any bargain-priced brand from the supermarket shelf. I did notice that it leaves my hair feeling a bit flat. There is no reason for the high price aside from name familiarity, as this brand is used by some hotel chains.

I really like the consistency of this face wash. It's like wet clay, with a gentle and pleasant scent. It has just the right amount of lather and it spreads very easily over my face. The only drawback is that is will dry your face out. I suppose this can be countered with a basic facial moisturizer.

This body wash is excellent. The scent is delicious, like real orange, the lather is thick with small bubbles, and it noticeably moisturizes your skin. The only drawback is the price. It's currently listed for $10 for 4 ounces, which is basically travel size.

I wasn't expecting my mirror to get a cleaning also! I was excited to finally have a water pick so when I received my package I immediately set it up and studied the directions. Once I was confident, I began and as soon as i turn it on, water went everywhere! It all ricochet ed all oclver my bathroom counter and mirror. Safe to say that you literally need to use this in the shower. But besides that, it has many attachments, different speeds and does a great job!

This is my own personal experience with this lash growth enhancer and my own opinion. I did not notice any difference in my lashes since I started using it a month ago. I've documented my experience with pictures every 3 days. I gave it 2 stars and not 1 because I've seen that it's worked for others but I guess it isn't compatible with my biology. I'm  bit disappointed.
One liter almost lasted a year.... I forgot how much I spent but it's worth it

This was a new thing for me to try.  I liked it but find myself not using it.  I thought maybe my wife would like it but it seems that she is not using it either.  It seems to take more soap than just using a washcloth.  I do like how it feels when I use it.  It feels nice on my body.  I won't give up yet, I will keep trying it.
I ordered these as replacements. They arrived on time and were just what I needed. They were affordable and practical. Definitely worth purchasing.

Besame classic lipstick (Forever Red 1925) is creamy, moisturizing and conditioning. The color is a bright red, which gives you just the right amount of pop, especially if you are wearing a solid color (like black, blue or grey). I wish it was a deeper red, but regardless I will make it work. It makes my lips feel soft and smooth. It isn’t drying at all. It doesn’t bead on your lips. I wouldn’t consider this a matte finish, but it isn’t really shiny either. It has decent staying power (you can eat or drink while wearing it). Overall, this is a terrific lipstick to put in my rotation. I’d recommend it.

I like that this set (Fragrantshare) contains a variety of (make-up) brushes. You get 18 brushes in different shapes and sizes. You get everything from a foundation brush, to one that you can apply eyeshadow with. They (black) handles are easy to hold and use. The bristles are made of animal hair.  So, far I haven’t noticed any shedding. Everyone knows that you should change out your brushes every once in a while. So, give these a chance. Did I mention, this set is inexpensive, under $21 on Amazon.

The Ikoo Infusions hair mask was surprisingly great. It is moisturizing, hydrating and nourishing. This product comes in a round (6.8 oz) container. The thick (light green) cream smells refreshing and bright.  Some of the ingredients are macadamia oil, honey extract and camellia oil. It is non-greasy but does leave a slight shine. This product is cruelty, vegan, sulfate and paraffin free (Peta approved since that is important for some consumers). I have coarse, sometimes dry hair, that after using this product made it more manageable after just one treatment. I used it as a deep conditioning treatment. It left my scalp and hair feeling refreshed and clean. I’d recommend it.

Clearly Amazon has mis-priced this brush. $50, for a plastic handled brush and firm bristles? First, I am ok with the plastic handle. It is easy to grip and hold. And since it is plastic, you don’t have to worry about it looking faded after several washes (I do clean mine) like you do with the wooden ones. I’m even ok with the firm bristles (nylon and boar), because I have coarse hair and I’m not tender headed.  I like that it smooths the hair easily.  What I don’t like is the PRICE. I can’t believe they expect people to pay $49 for this brush. Yikes! And the sad thing is that it didn’t even come in pretty packaging. Just in a simple white box. So, while I am sure I will use this brush, I can’t get over the price. 2 stars

LaClaire (Beverly Hills) Clarifying Cleanser is a delight on the skin. Simply add a dime sized amount, with a little water and distribute on your face with your hands (or if you prefer a loofah). The small (1.6 ounce) pump bottle is simple to use and doesn’t take up too much space in the cabinet or on the counter. There are some pretty nice ingredients that include tea tree oil, salicylic acid and aloe. I’ve used the product for a few days now and have not noticed any dryness or irritation. Nor have I noticed any redness or rashes. The scent of the cleanser is not strong (smells like tea tree oil) and does not linger long. And finally, what I like the most? This company has made a product in a bottle that is reusable. I really like companies who have a philosophy to reduce their impact on the world. Being socially aware of how their products can affect the environment and actively doing something about it is a company that I can support. You can reuse the bottle and add liquid soap or other things.

Ordered this for my son and he really loves it. He finds that this kit is helpful because there are a variety of tools that address most skin issues. He also likes there is a kit that holds all of the tools which means that he can keep them together and doesn't have to look for them when needed.  And finally, this kit was affordable and even more reasonable than some that I have seen in several discount stores.

This is perhaps one of the most difficult reviews that I have written in a while. Usually I know immediately if the product is a hit or miss, but Vitabrid C12 is different. I can’t decide. I’m torn. After using VC12 for about 3 weeks, I am still unsure of the results.

The concept: Vitamin C is slow released thru the skin by mixing a small amount of VC12, with water or a moisturizer, onto the face and neck. The results, brighter, smoother and firmer skin. The powder comes in a convenient small bottle (about the length of your thumb) with a small spoon (used for measuring). Simply mix the appropriate amount - I use about 2 spoonfuls since I put it on my face and neck- with a lightweight moisturizer. I didn’t notice any tightness, irritation or itching after I applied this to my skin (i.e., face and neck). I simply apply my makeup as usual. With that being said, I haven’t noticed anything bad either -no additional breakouts and no nasty white film (left on my face from bad blending). But I also haven’t looked in the mirror and said “wow” or “gosh, this is like a facelift in a bottle moment”.  Not to mention that this product takes a little more effort than my usual skincare regime. I am not use to mixing products before I use them. **Therefore, I am going to give this product 3 stars BUT continue to use it for a little longer to see if I am wowed. After all each container is believed to last about 3 months. If I notice something earth shattering in the next month or so, I will amend my review. Otherwise, this review will stand.
If you have larger head, these don't stay on. They're too tight and it causes them to slip strangely. I like the button idea though, and they worked fine for my regular headed coworkers.

I am not new to nail stamping, but I only recently became aware of She Modern Sticky Stamping Polishes. With traditional stamping polish it is necessary to work very quickly in order to successfully transfer the image onto the nail, and beginners frequently struggle to get the timing down. Even experienced stampers have difficulties with extremely fine lines or highly detailed images; the stamping polish just dries too quickly inside the very shallow etching. After watching several She Modern videos on YouTube and ordering a small set of sticky stamping polishes, I was eager to test them out on a stamping plate I’ve been unsuccessfully trying to use for over a year. My very first effort was flawless! The She Modern performed perfectly. Beginners will definitely find these polishes far, far easier to work with as they learn the basics, and more advanced stampers can enhance their artwork by using pigment powders, foils, and glitter. In addition, She Modern offers a comprehensive selection of watercolor polishes for techniques such as lead lining, reverse stamping, etc. The only limit is your imagination and She Modern even helps with that by providing live demonstrations of their products and techniques on YouTube every Tuesday and Friday. Tina very thoroughly and patiently opens each session by answering any questions from attendees before creating a nail design with various products. So part of my rating is based on the product itself and the other part is on the price for this size. Another thing I want to mention is that I have sensitive skin and have never had any issues with this product line! You’re face will thank you!

I not only followed the instructions to the letter, but had several exchanges with the seller to make sure what I was doing was correct.  The good news is that this combination beautifully toned down the red from all my prior years of using henna only.  The bad news is that NOT ONE gray hair (I'm dark brown with about 15% gray) gave up being gray! So in addition to the hassle, mess and expense of doing this treatment (and make no mistake - it's messy and time consuming) I will have to double up this month and do my regular henna only routine.  I did a bit of research, by the way, and learned that most henna/indigo distributors, unlike Harvest Moon, suggest mixing up the henna and indigo powders SEPARATELY and then combining.  Based on my experience, I'd have to say this would probably work better (the rationale probably being the same as why combining shampoo and conditioner together don't work as well as shampooing and THEN conditioning).  Likewise, everyone else except Harvest Moon recommends wrapping the hair in plastic wrap and then covering with a shower cap and leaving on for a MINIMUM of 2 hours (Harvest Moon says their product works in less than one hour and is against wrapping.) If you're new to stamping or not familiar with clear stampers, they are more delicate than opaque ones and tear easily, so be gentle with it. Wash it with dish soap & warm water, dry with a paper towel and clean it with a lint roller or tape. Never buff it or use acetone, you'll make it cloudy defeating the purpose of a clear stamper. When picking up, ROLL GENTLY over the image if you apply too much pressure it won't pick up. When applying the image to the nail press straight down (again, with GENTLE pressure) and rock side to side or roll from side to side. Don't push the tip of the nail into it, it will tear.

All the plates stamp great, I didn't swatch every image, although plates 29 & 41 have shallow etching (in my experience this is normal for BP plates) so the thinner scraper is a nice addition. It's not as thin as the 0.5mm and not a thick as the 1mm ones I own, I'd say it's 0.75mm (I didn't get out the calipers). There are different size images, a little for every nail size. But I do wish the water marble designs were bigger, I'm not a Water Marble Witch yet. Plate 52 is great for lead lighting or Sharpie water coloring.

The stamping guide works like it's supposed to, I've added a photo to show how it's used just in case it's confusing. I have a set of 4 templates from another brand already, there's not much difference in size or thickness of the metal but the designs are different. The edges aren't finished, like a plate with no backing, but I don't think it would cause anyone to slice their finger open unless you're being extremely careless.

All in all a great set.

"Jeff's Wife" - This is not true to color, it dries quite a bit darker, as you can see from the pic, but since I only use it for nail art I don't care but some of you might. I bought the pink back in Feb. 2015, still using it just got tired of the color, and this one seems slightly less opaque but maybe it's because that one is pink on pale skin but a second coat fixes the opacity, (only 1 coat in the pic). It may leave a few specks of the shimmer on your skin when you peel it off but they wipe away effortlessly.

If you're new to nail art and want to use this for that, I do suggest you transfer some to an empty polish bottle (cleaned with acetone or brand new doesn't matter) using a syringe with some sort of tip, an eye dropper or even a straw, this will keep the large bottle from drying out. This 4 oz bottle will last you a very long time, I still have about half the bottle I bought in Feb. 2015, and costs a fraction of the price as those other brands marketed specifically for nail art.

"Jeff's Wife"- These are so good! I only wish I had the original versions to compare. I've only heard negative things about the original stamping polishes from BM so I don't own any, I've only used MdU. But when BM reformulated their stamping polishes I gave them a try and I now own all the new collections so I gave these a try too. Boy am I glad I did. These DID NOT DISAPPOINT! I don't own white stamping polish, I use Sinful Colors Snow Me White that has been open for 3 days, it works but it's still not proper stamping polish. The black I use is MdU, the absolute holy grail of stamping polishes. But I have to say that these are beyond good! This black is comparable to MdU black in every way, except the smell. These have just become my favorite! I don't think I will be ordering from anyone else anymore.

Well built and compact. The charger base works well.

So far the 'waterproofness' has endured splashes, but don't dare try to dump it in a tub of water.

The brushes work well and are replaceable. They should be available on Amazon.

The case is a cool and shiny white patent leather.

"Jeff's Wife"-  Great plates and images that stamp beautifully, as always from Cici & Sisi. I do have two issues. One is that four of the six sleeves are cracked in the corners, like it's old, dried out plastic but I guess it's nothing that some packing tape can't fix. I've never had this issue with the other five sets from them. The other issue is the holder feels a bit more foam like instead of the pleather like the previous ones. But those issues have absolutely nothing to do the stamping ability of the images which, in the end, is the most important thing!

This is my first time using plain silk wrap and I love it!  I started using the self adhesive silk tabs to fix cracks and they worked great so I wrapped all my nails but I had to keep buying them. So I upgraded to this. I'm so glad I did. Yes it takes longer to do my nails now but it's so totally worth it. I wrap my nails every week or so and there's still so much of it left! I will not buy anything else, EVER!

Ideas are limitless with the buffet sections on the three plates. Like the other sets it's difficult to get a clean scrape on some of the corner images. But I do think it helps if you have a very flexible scraper, which I don't.
If you like bay rum, then you'll like Florida Water. If you don't like bay rum after a hot shave then something is wrong with you. Turn in your man card immediately.
It was hard to wear and didn’t stay tight in my head so I returned it.

I didn't see any reviews for these headbands and took a chance. I absolutely LOVE each and every pattern that is in this set. Nothing too crazy, but just enough to add a little extra to an outfit. Would highly recommend these.
Cleaning plaque & flossing.

What a complete waste of money! I was pretty disappointed with this product. It absolutely did nothing for my lashes in terms of lengthening or thickening. I thought I would see some improvement but nothing changed in my lashes at all. That being said, it does seem to condition them pretty well, but not worth the money in my opinion.

I love this! I have Rosacea and the grape seed extract helps broken capillaries in your face which is great! I wash my face in the morning and apply a little bit to my face which helps my foundation go on really smooth!

I discovered this brand through my ipsy bag, and was excited to try a few more best sellers from this brand. I personally love the vitamin c serum and the moisture boost cream. The squalene oil is great to mix with foundations that are a bit too drying without disturbing the coverage level or texture. Overall, great set.

This is more of an oil than a serum in my opinion. It does absorb immediately and does not smell strong like many vitamin C serums. It smells very light and fresh with the slightest citrus scent to it. Great to use for both day and night. Does not contain a sunscreen, so make sure to use one during the day. Overall, highly recommended.

I have very sensitive dry skin, So I was worried that this would over dry and irritate my skin. First of all, it smells amazing. It smells very natural, like greenery and botanicals. This mask has ever so slightly some grit to it. It isn't the scrubbiest of exfoliating masks. The clay doesn't over dry your skin. I do not feel like my skin is tight feeling after washing my face. Overall, it feels very luxurious and relaxing. Great weekly skin treat to unwind at home. Highly recommended.

I have used the Farmacy cleansing balm for 3 years and this is the first time I have used another brand. I find this balm very hydrating. It removes waterproof makeup very well, has a very fresh scent and with a bit of water turns into a milky cleanser. It also comes with a scoop for sanitary use. Overall, it is a great cleansing balm at a reasonable price. Highly recommended.

This is great for minimalists or teenagers. Keeps your essentials organized. you can keep makeup brushes and a few cosmetics in it. It also keeps jewelry, hair ties and other small items organized and easy to find. The mirror is removable as well. Very nice size, and can easily be wiped clean when needed. made of a thick plastic, and the holder slots are silicone. The mirror is a glass mirror. Overall, highly recommended.

These are very good nail files. They work very well, and lasts through multiple uses. I have natural nails, and I I find that the two different grits work well with smoothing edges and removing sharp corners of nails after trimming. I was replacing my old files after every use and the sand was flaking off and getting all over my floors. I did not have any problems with these doing that. Overall, it's a very high quality product and I would highly recommend it, especially for professional use.

I use this at night time as a serum before moisturizer. It smells wonderfully first if all. The texture is very thin and lightweight. It sinks into skin quickly. I do recommend wearing sunscreen during the day time as it can make your newer skin photosensitive. Overall, it's a very easy way to apply vitamin C to brighten skin and even skin tone.

These are perfect for on the go and travel. Don't leak and the pads are nicely saturated. Great to keep in makeup bags or even as a stocking stuffer. I don't use perfume everyday, so these last me a while. Nice way to try out a fragrance before committing to a full sized bottle as well. Highly recommended.

This makes hair styling very easy. Looks professional, and comfortable for all day wear. The band itself is kinda fragile so you have to be careful not to bend it too far apart or it might snap. Overall, it's a good product.

I use this to fill with rubbing alcohol to use as hand sanitizer. I clip it to my bag and use the sprayer to disinfect shopping carts as well. Super handy. They sprayer works very well and does not get clogged. Overall, highly recommended. Have filled all of them and given them to family members to utilize as well.

These are real Korean face masks from a great brand. I first discovered this brand from a subscription box and am now hooked. The box contains 10 masks and each are individually wrapped. They have a generous amount of serum in each. Great as a weekend treat at home after a bath. Overall, highly recommended!

This set of scrunchies and sunglasses for a bride and her bridesmaids is silly but fun. The scrunchies are made of a nice satin type fabric. The sunglasses don't actually offer much sun protection, but they are cute.

Overall, I like this powder and feel it is a good product. I have pale skin that can look sallow at times.  I like the pink tone to the shade that I got. The powder is easy to apply with the small puff included, but I prefer to use a soft applicator brush. This powder does have a bit of sparkle in it, which I don't always want, but it adds a nice glow for nighttime use.

I wasn't really sure what dermaplaning involved before I ordered this product. I watched a couple of youtube clips and decided to give it a try. These tools are bladed scrapers that are used to gently scrape away dead skin and tiny hairs to give your face a fresh, clean, healthy look. In the videos I watched, there was a considerable amount of icky skin removed- literally piles of it! My experience has been much less dramatic. A whole face application resulted in just a tiny amount of "dust" to be removed. I applied a bit too much pressure at first and gave myself a little scratch, so do be cautious. These blades are sharp!
I feel that my skin does look brighter and more healthy. Those videos of dermaplaning likely feature models who had been tanning and not washing their faces so the dirt and oil really built up, and skin was ready to peel.
This product removes tiny "peach fuzz" hairs but I also tried it on a small patch of coarser leg hair that I had missed while shaving. It took it off neatly with no irritation.
Takes me back to childhood. I basically used this in lieu of a vapor rub. It really clears the sinuses. And the tingle feels great on achy spots.

This stuff smells like hand sanitizer. It smells like straight rubbing alcohol and has a strange texture where it balls up when you rub it in. When I got to apply it to my sons face he yells that it hurts his eyes, and I tried it too and it's like rubbing alcohol is just evaporating into your eyes. If you do get this use it on arms and legs, then get a separate one for faces. That's kind of a hassle though so I'd just nix it all together and get a kid one that doesn't burn their eyes.

I was also disappointed that it doesn't go on blue and fade. There's really no way to see where it's applied unless it does that weird crumbly thing, in which case I'm not sure if it's spreading onto the skin or just clumping up.

I have short, stubby lashes so I was excited to try this. I ended up being pretty disappointed. At first, I thought the mascara was dried out because it looked like there was nothing on the brush. I have dark lashes so I couldn't see anything go on color-wise. I rubbed my hand on the brush and there was mascara on there, it just really did not thicken or lengthen at all. The bristles are also molded plastic, so they are scratchy and do not work well at distributing product. It's one of the worst designed mascara brushes I've seen. I thought it was old and dried up that's how bad it was. I will not be using or purchasing this mascara again.

Prairie Rose Organics Mint Cocoa Velvet Body Cream is just that - thick, rich & creamy. Seeps into my skin to create a moisture barrier and the scent is heavenly! This has a very “true,” pure blend of cocoa and peppermint. This will make a beautiful gift!

I've already used them all and they work well and feel good on my skin! The set comes with four pieces and a handle. The tools are all made of natural materials: shower bath brush, body massager, dry brush/pumice stone & loofah. The natural boar bristles bath brush is terrific - I can reach everywhere and it feels great on my back. I really jammed the handle on tightly and it didn't come off the brush while I was using it in the shower. Yet, I was able to remove it when I wanted to attach the massager. These can be used with just the attached handle strap, too. The loofah and pumice stone work great on my feet. Good quality, and I love the way they are packaged to make a nice gift box!

My husband and I have both used these. I like the hydration, the hydroxy acid and the feel of these -- I do not find them too abrasive at all. I find them to have a very mild exfoliation and very mild peeling effect. My husband says that his skin tingles after shaving because they have alcohol (this has very little alcohol because it is listed way at the end of a long list of ingredients). So, I like them much more than he does! These pads are embossed with charcoal powder that draws impurities out of the skin and clarify the pores. My skin feels extremely soothed and hydrated after using these!

My favorite soap!

This smells heavenly! I'll get a whiff of sage while reading in my bedroom, even though the bars of soap are in a nearby bathroom. And it is DELIGHTFUL -- like the great outdoors! Invigorating.

I'm using this in the shower as a body scrubber -- it's abrasive, with bits of sage in the soap.

It may seem a bit pricey, but these are large bars of soap.

Love, love, LOVE Pre' De Provence!

I LOVE how this product did give me a beautiful natural glow however, the cost of that flow caused my skin personally to break out. The same ingredients in the moisturizer and this spot corrector is what causes me to break out. So unfortunately this was returned.
I love this eye glitter but these were all dried up and old! They couldn't be used.
These are great!!! They have enough stretch to be useable but still tight enough to hold your hair and return to their shape. The colors are so beautiful! They really do leave no lines in your hair!!

Gel was very hard to work with and the fiberglass sheets were so thick they wouldn’t stay in a curve, they flattened out while curing the gel. Also any gel on the nail side of the fiberglass sheet would not cure right. I don’t know if this was because of the thickness of the sheets or what. Bought these to mend a small split over the quick on my nail plate (instead of using acrylic like I usually do) to keep it together until it grew out and it did not work. Won’t be using these again.
Love! I have terribly short lashes and this definitely built them up more than my typical layering of 3 mascaras.

My skin is really sensitive.

I also don't generally like all-in-one products. You should see my bathroom cabinets. Trying to consolidate, but I get different rashes in different places, and no one thing works for everything.

This is very gentle and did not make my skin or face or scalp break out or rash up at all. It's not super moisturizing, but it wasn't drying, either. The scent is very light, and the cleanser has a little minty/tingly kick. This would have worked for me in my teens or 20s when I couldn't wait to get out of the shower and on with my life.

This is a good moisturizer and plumper for people whose skin is just starting to age. The plumpers are conventional ingredients, but nothing of major concern unless you are allergic.

I did not get lasting results, but my skin is past just starting to age. I wish I'd had something like this at 40.

The NuDerma wand has done a lot for my aging skin. There are a few creams and sera I swear by -> modern science is pretty cool. It used to be that anything topical just sat on your skin doing nothing (except the one with the french name and gazillion dollar price tag - which, btw, you can get much cheaper in the blue german tin plus seaweed serum). Anyhoo - enter the era of home treatments. Thermal machines are great if you have the money, and for less (but still not cheap) you can get these wands that are practically miraculous.

Used correctly and alongside good skincare practices, they can clear acne, minimize lines, and restore an awful lot of tone and some volume to aging skin. They don't work for everyone, but my skin is thin from prednisone use and it's aging, and the NuDerma wand has been great at firming and plumping over time.

Mine came with the red wands, and I wanted to try the blue on my kid's pizza face. Did I mention that these things zap you?

Yeah, that's important. They zap you. You want to get some numbing cream. Anyway, he's never going to let me do this again, but it's too bad because it cleared his skin beautifully. And fast. And no giant pores from popping stuff. And because they are combination wands, I can use them on my skin.

All for a very affordable amount.

Among retinol creams can be a chore. The stuff is what it is, and retinol is good stuff, if you want to turn over your skin cells the way they used to do it for yourself.

This cream has an excellent formula of retinol, moisturizers, and antioxidants. What it also has that many others don't is a pump that keeps air and light from destroying the ingredients. It's 3% retinol, which is pretty strong, so patch test.

Recommend.

These picks use plastic, but very little compared to other floss picks. The floss itself is also very fine, which makes it great for my tight teeth. East to carry. Easy to use. Wish it had no plastic, but that's why I save these for the road, and just use a water flosser at home.

I'm bummed, because this seems to be working (eyelashes are way softer and less brittle), but it gave me a rash on my eyelids. I have lupus, and my skin is really sensitive, so this probably won't happen to you.

This one is easy to use and results are great! I have it for a couple of months now. That is when I decided to do my own nails with gel. My sister-in-law recommended this machine because it was similar to the one that she has. It is not used much because I do my nails every 4-3 weeks. Original drills are good for some applications, but I got a set of diamond drills for Russian manicure. Since then, I never had gel peeling off from the bottom (which was a common problem when I did my nails at the salon) because I clean my cuticles with this machine. I remove old gel with this machine as well. I am a very satisfied customer.
Really liked it and it is didn't lose any stones so far.

I have a lot of facial rollers. The Y shape is my favorite. The gentle suction massage is very relaxing. This one has a nice weight and feels well made. It rolls smoothly and silently. It came in a velvet pouch in a sealed bubble bag. It's competitively priced right now at $13.99 plus an extra 40% off.

I didn't care much for this sleeping mask. It came in an unsealed box. There's a plastic cover under the lid, but there was a mess of cream all around the rim and threads. Maybe it was used? It smells like lotion and salad dressing. It feels like Vaseline on the skin, which is okay for a sleeping mask. It made me feel like it was  certainly locking in moisture, but the next day, I didn't really notice anything different in my skin. I like sleeping masks but don't expect I would order this again. I definitely find it overpriced ($44) for the packaging, experience, and results - or lack thereof.

This came with a foil seal in a bag. It's a very sweet scented gel that feels nice on the skin - like a soft layer/barrier, but unlike other overnight masks I've tried, the effects weren't really apparent once you remove this the next morning. It's currently $12.99.

I used this later in a day, after derma rollering, and I felt it helped soothe my skin. No lingering irritation or redness from the derma roller. I'm not sure if it was this serum alone or how it worked in conjunction with my other skin care products, but my skin felt velvety soft afterwards. I enjoyed the lavender-scented milky texture of this serum. It came in a sealed box. It's affordably priced at $9.99. I would get this again.

I really like Everyday Beauty's Hydrating Instant Mask so was hopeful for this Night Cream, but I wasn't as impressed. It didn't seem to leave my skin quite as velvety soft or last as many hours, yet the Night Cream is more expensive at $38/1 fl oz. The Mask is $22/1.7 fl oz and can be used overnight as often as needed. I use it as the last step in my skincare routine. This cream came in a box, unsealed and simply smells like a cream.

If you love strawberries and/or are seeking a gentle scrub, this is a good choice. The sealed tub also had a plastic cover under the the lid and was boxed. The scrub had a little brown in it like what you might see when fruit starts to rot or in yogurt, but it's dated good until 9/14/2023, so I felt okay using it. The red particles made my husband and I realize we didn't confidently know the color of strawberry seeds, but I think they are. They feel kind of squishy, and the scrub feels more like a creamy moisturizing lotion. It does smell like strawberries and makes skin soft. This is a different scrub that feels gentle. I personally prefer one that feels like it's polishing and cleaning more than moisturizing though. This is currently $12.

The bottle came in a sealed box. It's a light pink gel. The scent is nice but more fruity-rose like you might find in products scented for children. It cleans okay. I don't feel it's worth $16, but I don't think I would buy this one again regardless.

The tube had a foil seal. There is a pineapple scent. You're supposed to massage the gel on dry skin for 2 minutes. As soon as you start, it starts to pill. I feel like most of it immediately dries up and falls off though I'm sure it's grabbing dead skin too. While it's gentle in that it's not using coarse particles, I didn't enjoy the dry rubbing and tugging at my skin. You can only avoid that over 2 minutes by applying a generous amount of gel, but it's a small tube. My skin looked a little brightened afterwards but not as soft and bright as many other exfoliators (scrubs, peels, masks, serums, etc). This is $12.99, which doesn't seem like as great of a value after seeing how much you need to use. I didn't like the application, results, or price enough to reorder this.

I have a lot of orange-gold lip colors because I find them very flattering on me, so I was pretty confident I would like this. The color is beautiful and not too orange. While I like the gold too, the specks of glitter are larger and more obvious than I would like. Some gold is really fine and distributes as an even shimmer across your lips. With this, you can see the glitter speck here, the glitter speck there, the glitter speck falling a little outside your lip line that will probably end up somewhere else on your face. It has more of a youthful, party feel. I agree it's a color reminiscent of sunsets, suited for summer and fall. The case is possibly the most sophisticated I own though. It has a nice weight, and the magnetic closure feels good. It came in a box and in a sealed bag. I don't mind wearing this color, but I wouldn't buy it again. I think I like the case the best, but I'm not convinced the color or feel add up to make it worth $38.

I've used a drugstore pressed powder for years and always gotten compliments, so it's hard to think I need to pay $52. I can't say I was especially impressed by this. HOWEVER, I'm getting to the age where I'm starting to notice my makeup can look dry and accentuate lines I didn't even think I had. I'm not wearing much makeup these days, but based on reviews, I got this with the hope it will work for maturing skin. I can see this also washing you out a bit as another reviewer mentioned. It's white, and even though I'm fair, I felt this needed a very light application. The good news is if such a thin dusting can live up to the reviews, it makes the price a little better. I was surprised how low quality the puff felt. It's very thin and almost felt rough.
Reviews when I ordered this were raving about it. It's not bad, but it's not all that. Many more reviews have been added since then that reflect that.

I needed a brush for my cats because the one I've been using removes almost too much hair and hurts my one cat plus it's uncomfortable to hold. The brushes I've been seeing look flimsy and painful with their wire tips. I liked the rubber tips on this so took the chance. It's working great so far. I can tell it doesn't hurt my cat...although she still doesn't love what's happening. It smoothed their hair without pulling it all out. The bristles kept their shape. The button pushed all the hair up, so I could cleanly and easily pull it all off. It's more comfortable to hold, and the cover is actually helpful to keep the bristles clean and protected from being bent. It's a little large for even my large cats but totally doable. It would definitely work for larger dogs as well. The price is reasonable and considering so many other similar brushes received poor reviews, I'm especially happy with this for the price.

I bought this out of curiosity about foam cleansers and because a reviewer said it smells like coconut. Actually, it smells like citrus pine to me, which makes a lot more sense looking at the pinecones on the package and the fact is says there pine leaf, grapefruit, and citron extracts. It's a nice scent if you like those. Anyway, I'm finding one pump of these foams work for me (maybe I would need more if I was wearing makeup, and I wish I could tell you how well this removes makeup). This spread thicker than other foams I have used so far. It felt like it did a good job cleaning and left my skin soft and fresh. The price is on par with other foam cleansers I've tried. This would last me a long time since I only need one pump, but I'm just as happy with cheaper cleansers with scents I prefer.
It did not do what it said it would

My daughter and I tried the lashes out as soon as we got them.  We wore them when we went out and they were beautiful and natural looking lashes.  We love these and I would definitely buy them again.  They came with a nice eyelash tweezer too!

I gave it four stars, just because the flavor is so strong.  Apparently I lean toward blandness, because others I've talked to like it as is.
I won't toss it out.  I just rinse more after using it.

This works so good on face and hands and other dry skin areas. It's easy to use and feels so good. It really hydrates your skin. I use it every week. I will be buying more as gifts for my daughters birthdays.

I loved that it came with an assortment of attachments.  There are three settings on the hair dryer; fan, low, and high.  Also it has a cool button.  Using it on low there was more than enough heat to dry my long hair in a short time.  The big attraction is that this takes up very little space in my tiny bathroom.

I bought this to blend my own tea, and I was very impressed with how fresh this was when I opened the package.  I don't know how long this will hold it's freshness.  That will be the determining factor as to whether or not I buy a bag this large again.
GOOD PRODUCT, EASY TO USE!
Great colors and nice metallic shine!  Will rebuy.
Love this product and the price much better than Mugler site!

I was searching for something with Volufiline and found this inexpensive  tube.  Thought I would take a chance with it being much less expensive than others I found. It was delivered  on time and packaged really professional  and nice. I couldn’t wait to dab some on my eye areas. I went back to the mirror about  30 minutes later and almost every bit of puffiness  was gone. So, I dabbed a little more around the area and much to my surprise, my eye area looked like I just had botox!  I have used it going on almost 2 days and have already ordered more of their products.  Going to see how the Gold Milk Steam Cream 200g does on my mature skin along with the Pancoat Pop Vita gloss+lipstick+tint works out.
These are Asian companies and made.. Just as the Manufacturer  describes  - "Cheap and works” . It has a nice soft aroma that goes away quickly as it is put on the skin.
I am shocked that there are not any other reviews for this product...
For the price and quality, so far I am super pleased and would recommend this product to others.

My skin has always been, at best, blotchy, and if I try some kind of coverup, i usually break out.  I'm not sure what led me to this, but I picked this brand because it didn't seem to have any ingredients in it that I needed a chemistry degree to evaluate. Good choice. No, great choice. I have been using it for three or four days, and my skin is obviously clearer, almost not blotchy at all!  This is amazing. (Would it work for you? Only one way to find out. Tty it.)

Shiny hair is nice - I've used a vinegar rinse for years, didn't need it with this shampoo.  However, my scalp itched incessently, and my hair continued to thin.  I think if I kept on using it, I'd have become tonsured.  I have gone back to the recipes in Grow Hair Fast, have made my own shampoo, used it for two days - and no more itch, and increased confidence I won't go bald.
Gets the job done.

I received a sample of this in my IPSY bag, fell in love, then began the hunt for the right shades. This is the best lip stain/ long wear lippie I've ever used. Great pigmentation, smoking the, feels like nothing when wearing, the only truly non-drying lip stain or extended wear lipstick I've ever used. It really does last all day. If going for full coverage make sure to give it a solid 5 minutes to set. The hardest part is finding just the right shade. I ended up scouring YouTube for swatches.  REALLY love and recommend.

Honest, these bottles and jars are great. High quality. I love that a spatula was included for the jars. I wish it was one for each, but really, I love the attention to detail there. I have used these, just got back from a short trip, and they will be going with me to Spain in 2 weeks for holidays. They do what they say they will, easy fill, click dial for the label, squeeze every bit out, no leaks. The zip bag ripped on second use. That was no bother to me,I didn't need it. EXCELLENT seller communication!  After purchase, I received an email to see if I was pleased, wrote back that I was, except for the bag, and described. Seller thanked me for honest input and is looking for a new supplier of more sturdy bags. Kudos to this little shop, I hope they do very well in the big Amazon world. Great customer service. Beyond the quality product, I would go out of my way to do business with this seller again.

My new love- Good bye pouf balls. This is amazing, really feels like it is exfoliating, especially now with my dry itchy winter skin. I love this. Kept one, will be giving the other two away with nice shower stuff as gifts, then will order more for myself. I wish I had of found these years ago.

Adding to previous review- I am finally ordering another 3 pack. I gave away 2 of the first 3 pack as stocking stuffers to family. Now everyone in my family is talking about these and wanting them. *Please note, if you have really sensitive skin (like me) these work great, just remember don't scrub as hard as you would with your everyday pouf ball thing. These do the exfoliating job just great without lots of pressure. Also, mine has held up beautifully. I throw it in the wash and air dry, still looks new. I really love how I can use on back. I know it sounds silly to get this lathered up (hahahaha) over a product, but this is a game changer.

This is a lovely smelling perfume smells just like Juicy!  It lasts a very long time just about as long as juicy does and it does not have  an over bearing scent like some perfumes it comes in a good sized bottle that will last me for quite a while! Very happy with this purchase will buy again and will also try other scents form Watermark Beauty!

I was fortunate to receive this product at a discounted price during a special promotion to test in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.
The discount has not influenced or impacted my judgement of this product. I take this seriously and include my own opinion and experience with each product I review. I am in no way required by the seller to leave positive remarks about their product. If you have found my product review to be helpful, please thumbs up this review. This will make it easier for others to find this review so they may be helped as well.
I have one in each car, my handbag, by the front door for when I get the mail.  I give them as stocking stuffers.

My wife is a professional hair stylist. She cuts my hair every 2-3 weeks and relies heavily on using electric shears to do so.  This unit works very well. It can work plugged in, or with battery, which should give you about 40 minutes of time per charge.

The shears are sharp and do a great job of cutting through my thick hair. The attachments are also very nice. Unlike other units that have 6 or 7 different guards depending on what you want to do. It has a fixed length one, a short variable one, and a long variable one. For my hair she used the short variable one.  The settings go from 1/16 of a inch up to about 3/4 inch, and the long variable one goes up from there.

Having the variable length guards is great as it reduces the number of guards you need and allows you to change lengths on the fly.

Using the shears without the guard is also good for trimming to the skinline, edging and shaping.

The only complaint my wife had is that she wishes it were a little more powerful on battery, but wasn't really lacking in power, it is just that she usually uses professional shears. This unit is actually as powerful or more powerful than most shears you buy at walmart or the like.

Overall a great shear for home hair cutting.

This is a great way to trim your beard. A definite step up from traditional trimmers. The magic in it is the vacuum that captures and stores trimmed beard and mustache hair instead of letting it fall into your sink to make a mess. You don't make your lady mad, and everyone is happy.

The trimmer itself fits comfortably in your hand. It has an detachable cord that allows the unit to be charged. It can operate on the cord or off it's batteries for cordless use. The trimmer is NOT submersible.

The attached guard can be adjusted to 9 length settings with a rotating selector. It can also be taken off for trimming necklines or other areas. There is also a separate smaller attachment that can be used for precision cuts.

The vacuum is power and made more powerful over earlier models through the use of the "Turbo" button that amps up the cutting power and vacuum power substantially.  When you are done cutting your hairs are captured in a removable tray for disposal. There are still a few hairs that don't get sucked up but it a huge improvement over using trimmers without suction.

The only negatives are that the hair capture cup is a tad small. There is also a plastic piece that guides hair into the cup that makes neck and cheek-line trimming a little tricky until you get the hang of it.

Overall a great trimmer for those of us real men with beards. A must have!!

My husband put this kit to good use so I asked him if he'd mind letting me know what he thought about it. He didn't mind at all and this is what he had to say:

"Very comprehensive, quality kit for men. If you're like me you will find there are items in here that you likely won't really need. I personally don't use hair pomade or those light shave creams. I prefer foam and my hair just sort of keeps my head warm.
Aside from the items I can't use there are some great items in here for everyone. The body scrub soap like and feel a good bit more fresh after using it. But my preference, and where I really came to appreciate this, was with the facial moisturizer and lip balm. I don't usually buy those items and let the winter have its way with my face. I ride a bike everyday. But using the items in this kit really helped me keep my skin from drying, and my lips. The lip balm tastes and smells great, too."

I really like this face wash. It's one of the most gentle washes I've ever used. It has the lightest smell of cucumber which I don't like too much but at the same time it is a refreshing clean smell and it isn't overwhelmingly strong. It seems odd to give a five star to something with a scent that isn't quite one that is liked but this is a very good face wash and I absolutely love how clean it leaves my face feeling. It doesn't cause a red face or breakouts. It does seem to help prevent acne and even help to minimize it when it happens. It's definitely a new favorite.

These headbands are fantastic. There are 9 in this set and they come in a variety of colors and designs. You get three velvet headbands with pearls- pink, black, and beige, 3 fabric headbands- 2 have flower patterns and one is black with white stripes, and three knitted- green, grey, and black.
These are very well constructed. The only thing is that after a little while they did begin to dig in bit where they rest at the ends. Not too much but enough to make it uncomfortable after a long period of time. They still so nice it's worth the slight suffering.
These are very nice and worth it.

This shampoo and conditioner leaves hair feeling clean, soft, and manageable after the first use. It smells nice, too, which is also a plus!
My hair is not that of a teen or even young adult anymore so it's been through a lot. When looking for shampoo and conditioning products I tend to look closer at those that claim to make hair stronger, reduce breakage, and things with words like "restore" and "fortify". These hit the mark so I decided to give them a shot.
I've been using them about three weeks and I think that they are definitely doing my hair some good. It looks healthy and feels very soft. The conditioner does a good job with tangles and knots. I do sometimes still use a leave in conditioner or separate type of moisture just because it's winter my hair is increasingly dry on any given day depending. I like this. A little goes a long way as well which is nice.

Unfortunately I wasn't a fan of this one. It didn't do much to help my lips. Rather than exfoliate it actually just seemed to dry out my lips and not just a little bit. It wasn't fun. Just apply a small pea-sized amount to the lips using a finger-tip, scrub gently in a circular motion to remove the dead skin cells for about 30 seconds then rinse or eat off remaining sugar. This mask is very nice. I have never used a mask like this one before. It's heavier than the usual thin almost paper or gel like masks that a lot of them seem to be. This one definitely has a bit more to it. It's also a two piece mask which is great in some ways because sometimes I looks like a one person comedy routine trying to get the masks on right while they flip and flop all over.
With this mask you put the bottom part then the top by your eyes, it makes it a lot easier. Then you leave it on for at least 20 minutes ( though it says to leave it on for 30 so I did that). When you take it off you gently pat the left over into your skin.

(3.5)
Beautiful scrunchies. These scrunchies are very nice. They are made from 100% real natural raw mulberry silk. What makes these special is that they are not supposed to pull your hair as much or get stuck like many others do. That is true of these! The scrunchie works great. It goes in nicely, holds the hair back, doesn't slide out, and when it's taken out there is little to no hair caught in it.
However, I can't really see that the price for one is a great one. This is something you have to sort of weigh the options out though for yourself. I have noticed less hair pulling and loss with this hair thing, but the cost is up there. It's a good scrunchie but it's truly up to you if you'd spend that much on one. Maybe the other options make the prices seem less daunting?

This body scrub is really nice.  It smells so good and it smooths the and nourishes the skin perfectly. When you rub this gently onto your skin then rinse it off you can instantly feel the difference. It feels as if all the dead skin has been removed and your pores have been opened. It leaves you soft and refreshed as well as incredibly relaxed.
This is a big jar as well that you get and it's worth it for the price. It's definitely worth giving a try if you are interested and able to. It's really good. I love it.

These underarm sweat pads are just the thing for that extra protection in times of need! Sometimes no matter how much or what kind of deodorant you use, you just can't seem to stop the unsightly and ever so embarrassing pit stain of doom.  With these placed in your shirt the sweat never reaches your shirt and your garments are saved!
These work very well. To use them you simply lay your shirt down flat, remove the covering over the adhesive, place firmly in the spot needed, and you are good to go. When you are going to take it off remember to very gently remove it because it can become pretty sticky. It mentions this when you read about the product above but it is worth the reminder here!
These work very well and are a good option if you have problems often or occasionally with sweaty underarms.

A few things here …

LES ENFANTS is French for CHILDREN

It doesn’t refer to infants or toddlers. For those who don’t know, a quick note …

Newborn – birth to 4 weeks
Infants – 4 weeks to 1 year
Toddler – 1-3
Preschooler – 3-5
Child – 6-13

That said …

It does state NOT TO SPRAY IT ON A BABY’S SKIN. “Applying gently on clothes” is the preferred method. Though to be honest, I’d say this is more for ages 6+

While baby cologne isn’t something I would use on a baby, it could be better for adults who want a light scent and not overwhelmed by a perfume.

For almost $30, this is an 8.5 fl oz spray. Compared to some perfumes and colognes, this is moderately priced.

Smell? It isn’t the greatest. I do like it as a light, after-bathing scent. It seems more suited to a room freshener than a perfume. But, it isn’t the WORST perfume/scent I’ve smelled.

The generous size means it will last a while.

Would I get it again? No. Nor would I recommend it either.

This is an exfoliating facial cleanser that really didn't feel that great or give me that much in benefits. For $23 it is not something I'd get again or recommend. It was slightly overpriced and overhyped.

This is, for less than $10, a lovely comb.

Can function at a wedding or other event. However, the cons outweigh the beauty.

Given how delicate this is, there is NO storage box or bag. So, after use – where does one put it? That is an issue for me. Even a simple velvet type bag would be a good idea.

Second? The comb itself.

While absolutely stunning in design – function is a bit questionable because of the construction. The combs are “OPEN” design – thus loose hairs can weave in, particularly those with thick and curly hair. This makes removal or readjusting a bit difficult if not a tad uncomfortable.

This is also for thicker hair, not thin, and thus circles back to the issue I just presented.

While pretty, it isn’t something I am particularly pleased with. It isn’t something I would get for myself again. I also wouldn’t give it as a gift.

I think a lot of us want an easier way to remove hair. Shaving, especially for a bigger girl like me, is not that easy. It’s worse when you have long legs, short arms.

It’s bad when you have certain chin hairs (thankfully not that much it isn’t manageable another way).

I tried some sugar wax kit back about 20+ years ago. That was a NIGHTMARE! It was supposedly edible. I think you microwaved the container, spread it on, let it cool, used a paper strip (supplied) to remove the hair. It didn’t work and stung.

I then moved to a hair removal cream, that partially worked.

After that? Back to the hold stand-by –> shave foam/cream and a razor. For my main body parts, that’s always worked. Tough “chin” hairs –> using a tweezer work. No, the dermaplaning tool didn’t work on them.

I got a wax warmer, so I thought all beads/beans were equal.

These came with ZERO instructions, and the after spray bottle was busted. The warmer kit at least had some. And, my warmer kit had specially made, disposable “cups”.

These beads/beans, in a smaller cup, took over 90 minute to melt. And, the warmer was on 180°(F).

I tried a small amount on my arm. The wax was sticky, not liquidy, and it cooled almost as soon as it hit my skin.

I let it sit there for a few minutes (over 5), and peeled the max off. It didn’t hurt, sting, or cause redness – then again …

THE HAIR WAS STILL THERE

Okay, so my hair on my arm is a little thin. But, if this removes thick hair, shouldn’t it remove thinner hair?

I found another patch, got some warm wax – tried it again. Nope. Tried legs, arms, and under my chin. Nothing. Then again, I see I'm not the only one experiencing issues with these beads/beans.

I may have gotten a bad batch. But, I definitely wouldn’t get these again.

As most have said here – these are great for travel, especially when you can’t find soap around but have water. Though I wouldn’t carry a bar of soap, I have used “travel” size body wash as a hand soap. If it cleans the body, should clean the hands, right?

Anyway …

The metal container I got was dented, but that is okay as I don’t intend to travel where I won’t have soap. So, I’m using these at my bathroom sink.

LET ME STATE THIS AS A WARNING: HANDS MUST BE DRY BEFORE GRABBING A SOAP SHEET.

I know all caps is yelling, but trust me – it is for a VERY GOOD reason. As one reviewer said, even a drop of water can damage these.

Basically I grab a one with dry hands, hold it in palm, turn water on, let it dissolve. Good lather, I don’t really smell a “scent”, hands wash clean. They don’t dry out, but I do use a moisturizing sanitizer, and hand lotion after.

I wouldn’t say these go years – if you’re like me and using them as an alternative to other hand soaps to preserve waste, they might last about a month (8 washes per day, 30 days). If only as travel backup – they might last a few years. Again, it depends on how they’re used.

I personally find them a bit on the pricey side at almost $10 before tax. That’s just me.

I do have other soaps, and these should last me a while. I would not recommend them as a body wash. As opposed to carrying a bar of soap, try a travel container with body wash. Just my suggestion.

This product as a lot going for it. I love the idea of the individually gift boxed tubes, the cap is wonderful (huge and easy to use), the product is generously sized.

The problem is that this stuff is runny, doesn’t absorb that well on me, and the “scent” that is there – it isn’t that great.

For $15 before tax, that is roughly $3.75 a tube, and while they’re smaller – I’d honestly stick with Bath & Body Works.

This isn’t something I’d get again and I wouldn’t recommend it. I also wouldn’t give it as a gift.

Colorful manicure and pedicure kit for home, gym, or travel.

Has most everything needed and easy to store. Love the pretty case. Price is great as well.

Each tool is functional and works great.

I have been trying, for well over 30 years, to get a curling iron that actually did what it was supposed to – curl my hair.

Hot curlers – no good results

Curling Irons (¼, ½) – no good results

 Wrap-Around Fabric Curlers – nothing there

I saw this and thought it couldn’t fail. Simple to use – plug in, turn on, heat up, section hair, and use – put hair in, count down.

Works in theory, fails in execution. First up – there is NO heat seating guide for SAFE curling. THIS DEVICE IS CELSIUS (C) ONLY, NO FARENHEIT (F) OPTION. Google is strongly needed here.

According to Redken: “For those with fine or thin hair, keep your iron set below 200 (so below 100°C on this device) degrees Fahrenheit. Any higher and your strands may burn. For those with coarse or thicker hair, have your curling iron set between 200 degrees and 300 degrees (148.9°C or on this device 150) Fahrenheit for optimal curls” [9 Curling Iron Secrets You Need to Know About/Redken]

Using that, as well as Glamour’s 8-10 second rule [How to Curl Your Hair Correctly: 7 Mistakes to Avoid – Glamour; “Drill it into your brain: You should hold an iron on your hair for eight to 10 seconds max”], along with using thinner groups of hair – I should have SOME wave. Nope. I even went 25 seconds. Nothing.

As my hair has become a bit thinner, has been color treated, and exposed to SO much – I wasn’t about to turn this up hotter.

The curler is designed much like a crimper, but the “width” can make it difficult to handle, especially by yourself. There is a “guard” which heats up as well and it is easy to burn yourself.

It wins with innovative idea as well as the digital temp gauge. Also, it does heat up SUPER fast, as well as cool down just as fast when lowering the temp.

For use by myself – this is a two star deal. Perhaps if someone else were around it might be easier, but this definitely did not work well.

I really wanted to LOVE this scrub – there was just too much wrong with it to even LIKE it.

First of all – this is FAR TOO THICK to squeeze out of the tube. I had to SMASH it with my arm to get it to MOVE.

The scent? If you’re looking for Bath & Body Works type of Cherry Blossom, you’re not going to get it.

Once you get it out, and can take the scent – after it is applied, it is a soft, moisturizing and no slip scrub.

This isn’t something I’d get again or recommend.

This UV/LED lamp is by far one of the best I’ve used. I have another one by OVLUX (one of my favorites). So, when I saw this, I didn’t hesitate to get it to have on standby.

There are a few issues with it, but I’m overall pleased.

Very easy to use.

Be warned, this is NOT “dip powder”. This is indeed acrylic powder in VERY small jars.

This does not come with instructions though – at least mine didn’t. So that could make this a bit hard to work with.

The colors are pretty though.

This isn’t the best kit out there, I have seen better ones. The packaging isn’t that stable or durable. I ended up putting the jars in a pencil case.

I honestly wouldn’t get it again. As far as durability, I usually do my manicure every week or so.

I mainly got these for a “home-made” gel soak off (using foil).

And, they worked! They don’t pinch at all; even my mom used them and said she could barely feel them.

Light weight and fairly durable. There are enough for two people to use at the same time, or extras on hand if they ever break.

If used for poly gels, I’m sure they would work just as well.

Pretty standard nail drill.

This is similar, if not identical to most of the nail drills used in the salon.

Best used to remove gel polishes and/or nail tips to prepare them for other polishes or plain removal.

Seeing this colorful and glittery set – I had to get it.

Great price point!

This is great eye cream, it hydrates and erases fine lines. It even gives a bit of a glow and looks great under makeup. The cream is thick and rich, one of the best I’ve ever used. And it will last a long time!

Thin Bamboo Sheet Sap infused sheet facee masks with rice essence extract cream for intensive moisturizing for pore reduction for all skin types, product made in Korea

I really like this line. I see improvements using the exfoliating scrub, the toning serum and my favorite is the hydra-whipped moisturizer.  The scrub and the serum are also sold separately in full size bottles but the hydra-whipped is not and I'm so hoping it will be in the future. Omg these are wonderful. I used to rub ice over my face in the morning years ago. This is much better. It’s nice to have 4 to keto cold but I have not had to use more than one at a time. I love this mask. It is very hydrating and the mask is thicker than most and clings very well.  The benefits last much longer than others I have used. This is by far one of my favorite masks and it’sa good deal for the price.

I love this mask almost as much as an avocado sheet mask I have. It really hydrates your skin and it is so soothing. I’ll be buying more of these for certain. I used this after a chemical peel that I use and it really took care of the usual redness I get.
This is one of the better HA products that I’ve used. It’s great for keeping my skin hydrated all day and hiding fine lines. Can be used at night and in the morning under make up.

I don’t know about you but I have been having dry hands from lots of hand sanitizer. And my poor cuticles. I only need to use it once or twice a day.
