I tried with several amounts of it and i could not sleep at all because of the sticky feeling. It was too much. It did not absorb into my skin. Obviously every skin is different, mine is sensitive and dry.
The consistency is like a heavy gel.
So, for me is a BIG no, but i will use it during summer after sun tanning, before shower. I can see that would be best for me....i even think it will work great if i storage it in the fridge before using it... just like a cooling gel.

A couple of times during the year I get my heels very very dry.
I ordered this mask and it was great!
It start peeling around day 5-6.. and it was soo relaxing!!! Just like when I was little and we use glue on our hands! Haha..
Well, my feet are soft and almost all the dryness got out.
Easy to use.
No strong scent.
It did not make my skin red or itchy.
Love it! Recommended.

This set comes in a plastic box, nice detail because you can use it for storage.
The clips are bigger than I was expecting, but they are perfect. I have very thin hair and medium length.
I like that they lie flat on my head. So they don’t hurt me if I’m using them for long periods of time.
Lightweight and well made. They feel sturdy.
The set also comes with hair ties, love them! Very soft. They are made on 1 piece of fabric which helps on the hair.
I really like this set.
Recommended.

I was hoping more of this oil.
First it does not have any árgan type of scent... on the contrary it smells like fried oil. Not good. It is not super strong scent, but definitely you can smell it.
Second, it does not absorbe fast. I was oily until I fell asleep.
It was lightweight.
I did felt my skin hidrates the next day, but not quite sure if this is better than other oils that I use.
Definitely, I won’t use it, because mainly of the French fries smell.

This was my first attempt to do faux eye lashes. I can not compare to other systems, but I love it! I use the 3 pair from the top. The look was pretty normal. I had to cut a little of them because it was too long for me.
The set comes with 2 eye liner, tweezer and 5 pairs of lashes.
The liner was easy to apply and then the lashes were stuck on it fast and easy.
I went to a barbecue with them and they stay in the entire time.
After, they go out without any pain. The eye liner was a little hard to take off. I use my makeup wipes in a hard way. Haha.
It did not make my sensitive skin hurt or burn.
I love it!

This is beautiful. Not only the box is very nice, but the case is stunning! Looks like a smooth shell. Very luxurious. Perfect as a gift!
It is however, because of the material, like a ceramic or something, very heavy. I think it will not be good as a pret a porter kind of makeup. But perfect for the one you leave on your makeup vanities.
The colors are perfect for my skin tone, I’m like a light brown tone. But I’ve found myself using it more as a eye shadow than bronzer.
The highlighter gives a pop of glow.
No scent on it and it stays perfectly during my days.
Like it. Beautiful!

First of all, I don’t use to much makeup, no thick layers of foundations. Just some primer, concealer, eyes and mouth.
For me, they worked perfectly! They are pretty wet, so they took off all my makeup easily.
They are small, so if you use more layers of make up you maybe are going to need more than one.
They are soft and have a nice scent.
I have mixed skin and delicate. They did not hurt me, burn me, or leave my skin red.
After using them, my skin feels clean and moisturized. Not greasy or dry.
And they come in a super handy little box, perfect to carry around on your bag.

I love this set! Even though I don’t need 6 of them.
They are well made, very stretchy, so I guess they fit a wide range of head sizes!
Super super soft. The fabric is thick.
Comfortable to use, it does not squeeze the head. But it holds all the hair back.
I use it when washing my face. It keeps my hair dry too.
I love the bow! Very 50’s!!!
Great colors. Like it a lot.

The concept behind this set of masks is pretty cool, and the names are cute.  The masks themselves, however, aren't anything to write home about.  They smell fresh in a more herbal kind of way, and the textures are a mix between creamy and gel-like.  The big issue I have is the container design.  The bowls come with a good sized amount because a little goes a long way, but there's no way to seal them back up for later use.  I had to put them in ziplock bags.

I couldn't use this but one time!  It broke me out, dried me out, irritated my skin, and the rose scent is overwhelming.  The texture is fairly decent as far as cleansing balms go, but it's a very aggressive cleanser and not in a good way.  My skin felt rough and raw when I was done using it.  I've used Clean It Zero for a while and highly recommend it over this balm.  Steer clear!

This is a really nice lighted, mirrored compact!  So many times, the lights aren't bright enough to do you much good, there's only a single regular mirror, and/or the size is just too small to give you a proper look.  Not so with this compact.  You get two mirrors for the price of one, a regular mirror and one with a higher magnification for those times when you need a closer inspection.  The light has a lovely, and very helpful, color temperature that's pretty close to daylight, just a bit warmer, and is featured around both mirrors.  It's operated by a switch on the bottom, so you aren't wasting your batteries.  It runs off of two coin batteries.  The mirror is larger than most.  I have larger than average hands for a woman, and this compact is bigger than my palm.  It's a great size for quick once overs and more detailed makeup application.  I even prefer using it over my bathroom mirror for doing my eyebrows.

After falling in love with the C.O. Bigelow Rose Salve, I knew I had to give this a try.  I haven't been disappointed with the results.  Not only does it have a sweet, citrusy smell, it also moisturizes and softens my dry, chapped skin.  I deal with dry hands in the winter and I'm a big hand washer, so I end up with rough, cracked skin.  This light yellow, creamy hand lotion has helped to keep my hands from feeling like sandpaper without leaving them greasy.

I thought this would be a fun wig to wear to bed, if you get my drift.  It's cute and the colors are blended together nicely, with small streak of lavender mixed into the blue.  The "scalp" looks great and is a nice nude color.  It mimics a Caucasian scalp really well, which is great for a pale gal like me.  The cut is sweet and it's styled well.  The bangs need trimming up but that shouldn't be a problem.  The tresses feel like all synthetic wigs do.  They are wavy but still have that plastic feel to them.  The big issue for me is the size of the wig cap itself.  I have black hair and the wig "scalp" is so short that several inches of the top of my natural hair shows through it.  It does come with a hair cap but oddly, it's black and not nude, which would be the smarter choice.  I have a nude hair cap that I'll be trying with it, but I'm not expecting much difference.  The wig is just too small in general.

I'll be honest.  I was rather skeptical when I received this.  It looks sleek and pretty but does it actually work?  My answer to that question is a resounding YES.  You wouldn't think a little buzzing device could make your skincare products do their best job but boy, oh, boy does it ever.  The three settings are for Cleansing (also used for extractions), Moisturizing, and Lifting.  Each setting causes the device to vibrate at different speeds and achieve different goals.  Using it is fairly easy.  Hold the button until you hear it turn on and then give the button a quick press to choose between functions.  There are lights above each mode and they will light up when you are on said mode.  The included instructions are very easy to follow and explain how to use it in a simple way.  It's all about keeping very light pressure, while holding the side bars, which add the effective charge to the device, allowing the ionization process to take place.  I have seen a difference in my skin already and I have only used it in each mode 3-4 times.  It could be easy to overdo it after seeing the results you do, but the instructions specifically advice you on how often each function should be used so the skin isn't having reverse effects from what you want it to.  I think the price for this item is fantastic!  I have a reduction in blackheads, my skin seems to glow after use, and my products are sinking into my skin better and faster.  This one for the win!

I'm someone with extremely thick and stick straight hair.  My hair loses curl within an hour of me fixing it.  I've tried other rotating curling irons and haven't had much success with them, so I didn't have very high expectations for this beach waver.  I have been pleasantly surprised.  Once I got the hang of it, I found it to be pretty easy to use.  It features buttons that allow you to chooses which direction you would like to curl each section of hair, and a Home button that after each use, and after the previous section of hair is no longer attached, allows the barrel to return to a neutral starting point.  I ran into an issue the first few times I used it, which was accidentally hitting the home button while my hair was still around the barrel.  This caused the hair to get very tight and the barrel to press up against the scalp.  This is very easy to do and I definitely think a design change should take place to correct this issue.  The barrel is long enough for my medium-long hair and I can see it needing to be used more than once up and down the length of long hair.  The curling iron gets up to 410 degrees max, which works pretty well on my thick hair.  I've tried fixing my hair in different ways after using it, to see which method holds the curls longer.  I still have an issue with my hair losing the curls a bit to quickly but it's remedied by using styling products before and after curling it.  To be honest, I think this beach waver is very overpriced.  Maybe the results would be better for someone with thinner hair but I don't think I'd pay more than $50 for this curling iron.  Nice results, but the design flaws make this a product I won't reach for that often.

I've always wanted to get into the art of doing my own acrylics so when I saw this drill set, I knew I had to review it.  Firstly, it comes with numerous accessories- a fluffy brush for removing dust from the nail and work area, a set of to separaters for painting, a nail board, and the drill bits themselves.  The entire set is nicely packaged and comes nestled in a velvety foam materials.  The bits are held in their own clear container within the box.  The set comes with a detachable adapter that plugs into the end of the drill and then into the wall outlet.  The drill itself is small enough to handle pretty easily, although I can see where it would be difficult for someone with smaller hands than myself (I have large hands.)  Inserting and removing the bits can be a challenge.  The mechanism isn't well made so I have to fight with it.  The power cord is much too short and I had to use an extension cord to give myself some wiggle room away from the wall outlet.  Some of the bits' textures do a better job than the others, while some don't do anything at all.  The over all look and feel of the set isn't worth the price, in my opinion.  It works a bit too awkwardly to be something I'd use that often.

I really enjoy this UV lamp.  It's sleek design and concept make it easy to use.  I like the buttons designated for each separate drying time and the LED display is easy to read and understand.  It works like a champ and does a great job!  I truly think this lamp is worth the price, and I think you'll like it as much as I do.

These are great cotton rounds!  I used to get the CVS 360 brand but they were getting expensive because I used a few each day.  Luckily, I found this huge pack of awesome rounds.  They are super soft but not so soft that they don't hold up when wet.  They are fantastic when you don't want to waste product because they absorb just the right amount and actually extend the life of my products.  The price is low and the amount of cotton rounds in this big pack can't be beat!

These are good for those late nights when you’re too exhausted to do your whole routine, although I HIGHLY recommend doing a quick double cleansing regardless.  They seem to remove dirt but don’t work well for removing oil-based makeup.  Make sure to understand that this has to be rinsed off, or you’re falling asleep with soap on your face.  I won’t be repurchasing.

This kit is a great deal!  I've been a devoted user of Korean skin care products.  For a while, I have preferred, out of several brands and types of sheet mask, the Benton Bee and Snail sheet mask.  Fantastic product!!!!  Firms, smooths, soothes.  It's great.  However, that's not why I purchased this set.  I have combo skin that leans towards oily in the heat.  Super oily T-zone.  After doing a ton of research, I decided to give the Benton Aloe Gel moisturizer a try.  I'd also heard great things about this foam cleanser.  I'm really enjoying the cleanser so far.  I wet my hands and face, use only a pea sized amount, rub my hands together to create the foam (not a soapy lather, but a thick and creamy foam), and work over my face.  I do this after oil cleansing.  This does a great job of picking up any oil residue and dirt, while leaving my face soft and refreshed.  Never tight and dry, which is the sign of an awful cleanser.  The gel moisturizer is okay.  Just okay.  I don't get as oily as I did with lotion moisturizers, which is great.  However, I don't have that supple, smooth feel that I'm used to and prefer.  I've actually noticed flaking around my nose, which is something I never dealt with after moisturizing.  A pea sized amount covers my entire face, it leaves a slightly tacky finish until absorbed ( I always let each of my products absorb for around 90 seconds before applying the next step), and is completely colorless.  Will I repurchase?  No, but I do suggest that you give this a try if your research and needs point you this direction.  Everyone's skin care needs can vary on several levels.  There are universal musts for good skin health, like cleansing daily, moisturizing, and using a good sunscreen.  There a a ton a variations of those products, though.  Finding the right routine and products can be a trial and error process.  The main thing is to stick to it.  The results are worth it!

This is a very nice magnifying mirror, in a beautiful oil rubbed bronze finish!  Especially for the price point!  There were very similar items for twice as much, but I'm so glad I chose to purchase this one for our bathroom.  My husband is starting to get more gray in his beard than not, and has been having trouble seeing it all while shaving.  I got this for him (and for myself, but don't tell him) and he has been thrilled with it.  The three lighting choices are gorgeous and very useful, as is the 10x magnification side of the swivel mirror head.  I'm thinking of getting one for my mom and sister, as well.  Great buy!

This wig goes greatly with the Ahri outfit! The wig is super comfortable and smooth on your head. I absolutely love the tail ends of the hair because of the yellow and pink combination color!! The wig goes down a little past my chest area. It may feel a a bit heavy, but is not too bad to wear for long periods of time for an event.

This product goes well with lightening up your eye. I found it is helpful to make my Asian eyes a bit bigger! I love the cute pink color and it makes your makeup much more attractive and more attention! Less is more is a helpful tip as the product can go on a bit much.
The clips are larger then I expected. The colors are nice. The quality seems to be good. Overall it is a nice set.

Ready to use straight out of the box. The color is pretty retro but it works. You will notice that it doesn't come with an outlet connection just a USB cable. You get a total of 6 brush head so you don't need to worry about replacements for a while. The brush heads aren't my favorite but they aren't bad. There is a control for the strength of the vibration which I love! It also gives notification after every 30 seconds, which is really great. Over all I am really happy.
It does everything it says it will. I like the simple style it has, and it is very easy to use.

If you want an inexpensive skin treatment for your skin to moisturize and keep it fresh and young-looking, this product has some good ingredients.  It says safe for dry and sensitive skin.  I have combination skin, and it works fine for me.

Ingredients include: 100% Vegan Hyaluronic Acid - professional hydrating serum,enriched with anti-aging Vitamins C+E and Green tea.  Also included is Jojoba Oil, Retinol and Aloe.

It fills in fine lines and plumps your skin, reduces age spots, brightens skin etc.

It is paraben-free, cruelty-free, hypoallergenic, vegan, and is a serum.

The price at $5 an ounce seems to be about 1/3 of other similar serums.

I use a rotation of products on my skin as each product has strengths and does what others don't.  This seems to exfoliate a bit, and moisturize.  My skin looked good the morning after I used it.  You can put it on under foundation the company says.

It has about a 3-year shelf life.  You will probably use it up in the first month or two.

This goes on easily - has a metal rounded surface which emits watery liquid slowly.

It does firm up the skin around the eye as it dries.

I guess it would be great to put on before a party if your eyes are puffy.  And at night to reduce puffiness in the morning.

Right now I like this product.  After using it for a longer time, I might love this product.

It didn't hurt my eyes, sting, or get into my eyes as some eye products have done in the past.  The ingredients appear healthy.

The product kind of rolls on like roll-on deoderant used to do.  So, it's not messy.

This is NOT to put on your skin.

This is to drink.

My husband and I tasted it and liked the flavor.  It is a yummy orange.  The expiration date is January, 2019.  So, you don't have to drink it right away.  You DO need to refrigerate it.  And use it within a month of opening it.  You take one tablespoon a day, and follow with 8 oz. water.

This is fairly expensive.  At $79 - about $2.50 which is an inexpensive meal.

Like the container and the pump action.  Product feels pleasant with a light scent. Not wild about the scent, but if this works, it's okay.  It goes on easily.  So far, I like the product.  After using it a month, will decide if I love it as for what it does for my skin.  Like the natural ingredients in the product.

Eyebrow Stamp Stencil Kit, Double EyeBrow
Stamp Kit, Perfect Eyebrow Powder Stamp
Makeup with with 24 Reusable Eyebrow
Stencil,2 Eyebrow Brushes and 1 Eyebrow
Trimmer (Dark Brown + Medium Brown)

My wife got this eyebrow stamp stencil kit for faster application. These arrived quickly, not that
well packaged but did not have any damage. She said that using the stencils does take some
getting used to, and the medium brown is a bit on the reddish side. However, the stencils
themselves are great. Since using these, her morning makeup routine has been faster than
before, now that she’s gotten the hang of using these. Four stars.

Not Or Omega 7 Sea Buckthorn Oil Soft Gels,
Anytime Face Wash, Facial Defense Oil, Skin
Cleansing, Skin Moisturizing Core Kit

This facial cleansing wash, with sea buckthorn oil soft gels, and the facial defense oil, seem to
work really well together. My wife and daughter both get small bouts of acne during the month
and they’ve both benefited from this kit in diminishing breakouts and gently keeping their skin
clean and moisturized. They both want to continue using it and see if the soft gels make a
difference, but until then they are very happy with this kit. Four stars

[The Skin House] Wrinkle Snail System
Cream (1.69 fl.oz / 50ml) Firming, blemish,
repair, anti-aging

It took my wife a while to try this cream since it was made with snail mucin and to her, that
sounded less than appealing. However, once she did try it, she liked it. She said that it left her
skin softer and well hydrated. It doesn’t have a bad smell, which she was concerned about, and
the consistency was smooth and not sticky. She has combination skin, so this cream will be
good during the winter months when her skin is dryer. However, she said she will use a lighter
cream for the warmer months. Four stars

Facial Steamer Nano Hot Steam Face Spa
Device Ionic Face Steaming Machine for
Home Facials Personal Moisturizing
Humidifier Vaporizer for Skincare Beauty

My wife has always wanted a facial steamer but didn’t want to spend too much money. So,
when I saw this one, I thought it was a good deal. So far, she really likes it. She says that the
water heats up quickly and the steam coming out is smooth and doesn’t spit out any water. The
little cool mist steamer will come in handy on hot days, which will be coming up soon here in
California. Even though this comes with some acne removing tools, my wife has not used those
so cannot comment on whether they are effective or not. The steamer and mister, however, has
been something she really loves. Five stars

Facial Cleansing Brush, Sonic Ultrasonic
Vibration Facial Brush, Red-light for Deep
Cleaning, Discharge Makeup, Gentle
Exfoliating, Blackhead Removing, Massaging
with 3 Adjustable Modes and Speeds

My wife has used many facial cleansing tools in the past, but wanted something with a little
more portability. After reading more about this brush, she liked the features it mentioned and
decided to try it. It arrived well packaged, and undamaged. It came with instructions and a usb
cord. After trying it for a while, my wife said she really likes the shape and the way it feels in her
hand. It is easy to maneuver around the contours of her face and she feels her face is getting
cleaner after using it. Although she likes the red light feature, it is not something she uses
regularly. She does like that it is small enough to carry in her purse. However, one of the main
reasons she wanted this is because of the waterproof capability. But with the usb port open, she
really does not feel comfortable using it in the shower. That was a disappointment. Also, it
does not come with a carrying case or bag, which would have been nice. I am giving it four
stars because the features we are left with are good ones and my wife feels that her skin has
improved since using this brush.

MD Complete Bright & Healthy Citrus-C Refresh Retinol + Vitamin C Multitasking Treatment

My wife got this multitasking treatment of vitamin C and retinol, to combat uneven skin texture and fine lines.  She used it for a while and afterward said that at least for her skin, she didn’t notice that much of a difference.  There was some brightening, but not effective enough as some other skincare products that she’s tried.  Overall, it may be good with those with minor skin issues, or maintaining good skin, but not if there’s a skin issue that is trying to be reversed.

Hylunia Facial Day Lotion - 1.7 fl oz - Anti-Aging for Wrinkles - with Shea Butter, Hyaluronic Acid Serum, Zinc - Natural Vegan Moisturizer - Rapid Skin Repair

My wife has recently started using Hylunia skin care products.  So when she saw their Day Lotion, she thought she would give it a try.  She is very happy with the results of this product. She said it plumps and smooths her skin and absorbs really well.  It goes on well under her makeup and does not cause her foundation to streak.  Even though it is a little pricey at around $67.00, it is definitely a product worth paying for.

NATURAL Moisturizing Facial Masks (ALOE VERA 4PK Box) | Deep Moisturizer Face Sheet Masks for Dry, Sensitive and Tired Skin

My wife really liked this moisturizing face mask with aloe.  She suffers from allergies, so her skin is dry and sensitive during those times.  This face mask contains clean ingredients, and is perfect to get someone with allergies and sensitive through harsher weather months.
I use this to wash my poodle and I love it!!
This is a nice little nail lamp, works just as it should, well made and it's pretty. Comes with some nice extra gifts as well. 5 stars!

I love this! Now I can set my nails in no time! No more nicks in my polish because I can't ever seem to let them fully dry before I have to do something! This thing is wonderful! I have only used it with regular nail polish so far, but my daughter has some gel polish I will try next. If anything changes I will update my review. I have a feeling my daughters and I will get plenty of use from this. Nice little machine!

Purchased two in late June. By August they are both not working. The light used to be bright and now just flickers off and on very dimly. Changed batteries. Still same thing. Don’t waste your money folks.

What a soothing and wonderful lavender smell this lotion has. It goes on smoothly and is not greasy at all. Moisturizes nicely, yet is not heavy. I find the fragrance very relaxing, with a natural lavender smell. I am enjoying using this product.
Nice salt scrub, leaves my skin feeling so soft and smelling nice.  Recommended.
Great polish remover.  I used it to remove three coats of polish and it took it off with one swipe.  Recommended

Very handy and work great.  Took these on vacation recently and it was great to not need to take the bottle and worry about leakage.  Usually one pad will do all your nails but sometimes it takes a couple.  Recommended

I have shorter hair and this worked really well for me,  I honestly wasn’t expecting that it was going to work in my shorter hair as the Barrel seems large but to the contrary it does a fabulous job.  Recommended

Good primer.  It sprays on and feels a little sticky for about thirty seconds but then dries and feels smooth on your face.  Makeup goes on great and stays on really well.  Wish it had an SPF.  Recommended.
Nice nail kit, very thorough on the selection of accessories.  Works great.

This stuff is amazing!  I didn't even know such a product existed and was excited to try it when I found it.  My baby shih tzu has a top knot that's in the awkward stage where most will stay in a band or clip but the lower pieces fall down into her eyes.

I applied a bit of this and all the hair is staying put, LOVE THIS SO MICH!  This tub will probably last me awhile but when it's gone I will be back to buy more.

My hair is long and very fine/slippery, so I generally find that jaw clips are too small to hold all of my hair, too large/weak to keep my hair from slipping loose, and/or too heavy and fall off off my head under its own weight. These clips address all issues fabulously: the long but narrow shape captures all of my hair but clamps it closely enough that the strands don’t slip free and the lightweight nature means that gravity won't pull the clip loose. I can use these clips for both a full bun (I do need to double my long hair over to fit in the clip) or a half-up style.

I do object to calling the shade of these “wine red” when the product picture is plainly some kind of magenta shade. The actual clips are darker and mauvier than pictured and certainly pretty, but a far cry from “wine red” still.

I don't find the dry shampoo powder itself to be much better than plain cornstarch or arrowroot flour, especially as a product for blondes. But, the squeeze top dispenser is excellent. I would not repurchase this, but plan to reuse the container for DIY powder dry shampoo.

Speaking as someone with black hair who did not realize this product was for blondes when ordering, this product had more of a white cast than most dry shampoos but it wasn't a huge issue---it largely blended away once worked in thoroughly as per usual. Last I checked, the version for brunettes was more expensive, which seems ridiculous.

This is a beautiful foundation. I tried applying this both with a flocked powder puff and a foundation brush. I did prefer the powder puff, which did a better job of picking up the powder through the elasticated net dispenser. The finish is what I would call a "luminous matte" or "lit from within"---it definitely wasn't flat but didn't look dewy or greasy, either. It applied very smoothly over some very textured spots on my skin and covered blemishes well.

Unfortunately, the shade range sucks. I typically need a shade described as "very fair", which are harder to find in mineral foundations. The 100 Light shade is too dark for me unless I also cover my whole neck and chest with it, but the finish is beautiful and I honestly would wear it out on days I'm wear a scarf, for example. I would describe this shade as fair-light or light with a neutral peach undertone.

If you are familiar with the Tarte loose powder foundation, this seems very similar but without the clay that tends to oxidize. They have the same style of packaging (elasticated net + stopper lid), same luminous matte finish, and similar longevity.

These are very sturdy bottles with a smooth pump mechanism. I saw no leaking when I used these to fly with shampoo and conditioner recently.

Each pump is fairly small and consistent, which makes it very easy to regulate the amount used. I think I will be using these regularly and not just for travel for items without a pump or where the pumps are very inconsistent, like body lotion.

Such as beautiful shade! I really like that the Cheek Pop formula can be applied very sheerly, which means that I, as a very pale person, can wear deeper blush shades like Cola Pop. I still need to be very careful to use a light hand with application, though. Also, the Cheek Pop formula is talc-free!
Great deal for the price. Not that easy to clean. But for the price I will order more and toss these out.

These aren't pads to clean make-up off your face(at least not fully), like I thought they were. They're actually supposed to be used after washing your face. After wiping your face with them, you're supposed to press any excess liquid onto your skin and then leave it. I found them a little too harsh for my skin. On the front of the container, it says they're soothing, but I didn't get that at all. My face feels scratched and irritated after I use them and I for sure don't like the feeling of leaving the liquid on my face. It's an itchy feeling and it makes me anxious, as opposed to soothed. I ended up having to wash it off after each time I gave them a try. I like the idea of them, but unfortunately, they're not for me.

My children don't like haircuts, but my 6 year old has an especially hard time with it. While these seem mostly targeted to babies, I decided to give them a try for my older children. These clippers helped the process and all of my children preferred them. That said, these do work better on thinner hair. My two older children have thick hair and these clippers struggled with it. I ended up using another pair of clippers to thin their hair out a bit before swapping back to these. I didn't mention trying new clippers or explain the swapping back and forth, but they still requested I go back to these. These clippers do still make noise when in use, but it is more muted than regular clippers.

Overall, I'd say these are great to use on thinner/finer hair, but for thicker hair, just be prepared to thin it out first. Other than that, I've been super pleased with them.

This cream works pretty well and it doesn't take much. It kept my hair from being frizzy and it defined my curls. That said, maybe my hair is too fine for it. It left an odd feeling to my hair(like a layer of residue) and it's super hard to wash out. Gotta take a moment to write a review because this is my favorite soap. And the other one is now stuck with a 3 star review average just because of that mix-up.

At first I was nervous that even with the exfoliation back (this one), it would not be as good as it was before when it had the exfoliation originally, because it used to be oatmeal for the exfoliation, and now it is coffee grounds.  I even sent them a note asking why they didn't use oatmeal any more, and they said it was because the oatmeal version would fall apart in the Amazon warehouses.  But I tried the coffee ground exfoliation - and even though it isn't quite as good - it's still great.  This soap beats any other I've tried to purchase, and I have purchased about 10 brands through Amazon that all said they were exfoliating.  Only one of them was exfoliating enough, and I like this one better.  (I forget the name of that other brand right now; I'm at my computer.  If someone really wants to know, add a comment and I'll dig it up.)  I really need a very strong exfoliating soap, and this one actually is strong enough.  It also happens to be a brown bar with a decent hearty soap material, as well - not phony - so it is all I need.

Just wanted to post this review to start to bring back some 5 stars for this company now that they've gotten things sorted out and have two varieties, one exfoliating and one that isn't.

*** UPDATE Nov 9 2015 ***
They have now added the exfoliating version back, in another listing.  That means people who love this soap for whatever other reasons without the exfoliation can give it 5 stars for that.  People like me, who can't find strong exfoliating soap from any other brand (I have specifically ordered at least 10 other brands, Loofah, etc. etc. just trying to find one with strong exfoliation - and none have it, except maybe Tasmanian (http://amzn.com/B00CQOHOXY (but this is better)), can now use Honest For Men again - their exfoliating line.  So not this listing, but the other listing.  Not that exfoliating soap should matter, but actually, I'd be scrubbing with rocks from brooks if humans lived out in nature.

*** Original review a few days before ***

This was my favorite soap - and I depended on it for the fantastic exfoliation, better than any other I've tried (and I tried a dozen kinds).

All of a sudden, in this last batch, they have simply removed the exfoliation completely.  Now, when you look at the website, it says "Important Information: We have recently removed our exfoliating oats and coffee grounds due to customer feedback. Well, I'm here to give you a 1 star review for this "important information".  There are 1,000 other soaps that you can buy with various interesting scents, etc.  But this was the only soap you can buy that had great exfoliation.

And now they've removed it.

Hopefully, the 'customer feedback' that caused them to remove the exfoliation will be blasted away by the customer feedback complaining that the exfoliation is missing, and they'll put it back.

In the meantime - goodbye, 'Honest for Men'.

The gene pool I come from has Viking, German, and Irish heritage -- resulting in a stiff wiry beard that defeats most cordless beard trimmers. Since the unit has no automatic shut-off when charging is completed, you have to keep an eye on it to avoid a problem.  That is my only gripe about this unit.  Not too many people have the time flexibility to watch it for the two hours (or less) it needs to charge.

I'm posting a pic of my hair pre-bleach, post bleach, and post pink dye. I probably didn't need to bleach it but the last time I tried to dye my hair with pinks (two different brands) it just didn't take very well.

This took very well. The kit includes all you need (I used different gloves just because I prefer others). The directions are simple and complete. I would say that if you have hair longer than chin, maybe shoulder length, you will need at least two boxes. I have a pixie cut and used about half of both the bleach and dye. I always follow the direction when bleaching and did follow their directions. I never follow directions when using these "Direct dye" bright colors. Instead of the 30-60 minutes, I left mine in for 5 hours. I got a very vibrant pink (a little more fuchsia than the pictures on the box).

My one complaint is that this definitely left me with more dye rubbing off than some other brands have. When I used other brands I might wake up the next morning to a streak light on my pillow and that was with lot of hair. Using this on short hair, my pillow looked like a pink paintball fight happened. This and all dyes like it will dye anything and everything they touch. So I highly recommend two things - 1. protect everything (your skin around your face and neck with Vaseline) 2. If possible do NOT rinse your hair in a shower/bathtub. If you have access to a stainless steel sink or some kind of utility / laundry room sink where stains won't matter, that is so much easier to clean.

I was given the opportunity to review Keeva's tee tree oil shampoo and fell in love with it right after first use. I wasn't around to when they were selecting reviewers for their conditioner but now that it's available for purchase I'm glade to say I've bought it for full sale price being 20 USD.  Like it's shampoo counterpart the bottle is 28oz total.

Texture: White and creamy
Scent: Pleasant and definitely not reeking of tea tree oil like it's shampoo sister
Slip: Slip is a product's ability to allow one to detangle hair effectively and not need to use too much product to do so. For the amount I used which is pretty standard across the board with all conditioners I've tried, this conditioner is rated at 5/5 for slip
Moisture: Next to none but that isn't a real issue due to most of the oils being found in Keeva's tea tree oil shampoo
Standout Ingredients: hydrolyzed keratin ( protein ), argania spinose ( Moroccan argon oil ), cetearyl alchol ( fatty alcohol )

Cons:
Cocos nucifera ( Coconut Oil ) isn't listed as an ingredient, however it is featured as an ingredient on the front of the bottle.
Melaleuca alternifolia ( Tea Tree Oil ) isn't listed as an ingredient either.
Both of these oils is on the front of the bottle being featured however, the product doesn't list the oils as ingredients.

Overall, I believe this to be a quality conditioner even better than some brands found in salons. Price of the bottle is reasonable for the quantity received. This conditioner does provide one with good slip and it doesn't leave hair feeling heavy or weighted down after rinsing. I feel that when used with it's sister shampoo, you'll benefit from this conditioner most .

This shea butter is a good quality shea butter. It is ivory and reasonably priced. As a person whose been using shea butter for well over 10 years for ecezma treatment I can say that this shea butter is a quality product. Although it is a quality shea butter, the way it has been processed left the butter very grainy and not as creamy as I was expecting. It is a thick, heavy butter that is solid at room temperature and has a lot of use for hair and body purposes. It is sourced from an area in Africa that doesn't produce a real rancid smelling butter. It smells distinctly like shea but not like the shea sourced from more eastern countries. The butter when applied to the skin feels thick and heavey but that isn't a problem for me. I would need to indirectly melt and re-solidify this butter in order to smooth it out and kill the grainy texture it comes with. I'd also whip this butter to make it creamy.

Price: Reasonable
Texture: Grainy but not too smooth, sort of like peanut butter but thicker
Color: Ivory, more of an off white, cream like tone
Scent: Hard to describe but it's distinctly Shea which never smells pleasing

Overall, this company's shea butter is a good quality butter, high quality for some but for me good/decent due to the fact it's grainy and doesn't have the smooth texture I'm used too. The color is normal and the butter feels thick, heavy and heavenly on thick dry skin like eczema. I'd recommend this company's shea butter and possibly repurchase in the future.

I've tried a couple of different types of epilators over the past 15-20 years.  While I was usually happy enough with the results, I rarely used them since it always seemed like you had to wait until the hair got long enough for the unit to grip the hair in order to yank it out.  And rarely did I really want the hair on my legs to reach that amount of stubble.  Not to mention the pain that is involved with epilators.  Yes, I am a weenie.

This model of the Braun Silk Epil removes much shorter hair.  It claims to remove hair that is as short as a grain of sand (0.5mm).  I personally find it requires it to be a bit longer than that to grip; but it does do a much better job of reaching short hair than others I've tried.  It has a pivoting head which lets it work around all your body contours.  A light on the unit allows even the palest, finest hairs to be visible.

In addition to hair removal, this epilator refines your skin.  A sonic massage system and high-density brush scrub away old skin cells.  This exfoliation helps to stimulate the regeneration of surface skin cells in order to create a smoother skin tone.  I do notice a bit of a smoother, more even skin tone on my legs now.  This sonic massage is my favorite part of the device...in part because I really don't like the tweezing part.

This model can be used wet or dry and uses rechargeable batteries rather than a power cord.

Unfortunately, I find that it still hurts...although not nearly as much as it used to.  With regular use, the hairs on my legs have become fewer.  Plus, the already pale fine hair is becoming even thinner and weaker.  Braun claims that it will keep your body free of hair for up to 4 weeks.  I usually find it to be somewhere in the 2 to 3 week range for me.  Still, that's nice for when you're going on vacation or heading off to the beach for a week or two.  I allow the growth to get to the slight stubbly stage and then I'm perfectly smooth for a couple of weeks.

I ordered this 3-pack of Salux towels for the shower to help with rough bumpy skin on the backs of my legs, and to have an easy way to scrub my back.

They take some getting used to, partially because they're so long and don't immediately lather like sponges do. I prefer to keep it folded, wet it, add some soap or shower gel, and rub/scrunch it together until a lather forms. I used it folded on my body, and then unfold it to full length to use on my back (like the picture shows). You have to keep it out of the stream of water, or else the soap will wash right out of it.

They were definitely much more harsh than I expected - I can only use them very gently, and can't use them at all on especially thin areas of skin like my shins, the tops of my feet, or my chest. I'd absolutely never use them on my face or neck.

After the first use, I noticed an immediate improvement to my bumpy skin. But after I began to scrub with them daily, I felt like it actually exacerbated the problem. Plus, it was just another item to keep in the bathroom and worry about washing every week. As a side note, I wish they made these in white or grey instead of the bright colors - I feel like they'd match so many more peoples' bathroom decor and I wouldn't feel as bad about leaving one lying around the bathroom.

Now, I just use a Salux once per week as an exfoliating treatment - they're definitely too strong to be an everyday thing for me, but it does the job and helps with my bumps overall.

I've tried many products for "extreme" hairstyles like liberty spikes and nothing comes close to the performance of Got2b Glued Blasting Freeze Spray. I've now used it exclusively for over 3 years and purchase it in multi-packs for team events.

I've spiked hair as long as 18-24 inches and, if you can find a creative way to sleep with your hair spiked so high, your style will last a few days, even if you're dancing in the wind.

Tips for use: Brush or comb hair. Depending on the desired style, it's often helpful to part hair into segments for spikes and using coated hair ties to keep the segments apart.  Apply spray to clean, dry hair.  Spray  Got2b Glued liberally (your hair should feel wet) first to the roots in small segments and dry with a hair dryer on a cool setting to establish the "base" of your style. Use your hands to shape it as your dry. (For some of the longer hair, it can become a  four-hand task, so get some assistance from a friend.) Once your shape is set, spray to the tips of your hair in small segments  and dry each segment before doing the next. When you've spiked all segments, give your entire style one more heavy coating and dry with the dryer.  For liberty spikes or other styles where you want the tips to stay tidy, apply a small amount of Got2b Ultra Glued Invisible Styling Gel (smile.amazon.com/Got2b-Ultra-Invincible-Styling-6-Ounce/dp/B004FQK7DA/) to the tips only and dry once more with the dryer.

Clean-up is also easy. Use a gentle shampoo and warm water.

I bought this brace after a fall in which I'd injured my knee, as well as my ankle, and needed to keep my knee completely immobile -- no lateral tuning or twisting at all, and restricted flexing and extension.  It was the third brace I ordered -- the first was not nearly strong enough, and the second sizing was off. I'm so glad I found this one: It's a superb brace -- fine, sturdy stays,plus hinges that let you adjust both flexion and extension. I initially thought that latter feature was something I wouldn't need, but it turns out to have made a huge difference during this first month of healing. (Needless to say, I could not have handled a sleeve-type brace -- the open front/wrap style was mandatory, and made my life so much easier.)  I've been wearing the brace 24/7 -- night as well as day --  for more than a month and it's been my saving grace.  Service has been superb, too: Before I ordered, I measured my thigh, knee and calf; I was on the cusp between sizes, and so ordered up. That seemed like a good idea at the time because it allowed me to wear the brace over my slacks, as well as under -- but after almost a month of continuous wear. the thigh (which was a little larger than I needed to begin with) seemed to have stretched out; I couldn't wrap the upper portion tightly enough and even with the straps cinched tightly, the brace slipped after an hour or two or wear. I wrote the seller and asked if there was a solution -- this brace was costly enough that I didn't want to have to pay out of pocket for a second one -- and they offered to send  me a smaller size. It arrived within a few days, accompanied by a label for free return of the first.  I couldn't have been more impressed or more grateful. I'd recommend this brace, and this seller, to anyone.

I do a lot of nail art that includes stamping, sponging and a bunch of other really messy designs. My problem is that when I do all of those things the polish gets all over my skin making clean up take a bit longer than I like. So I needed to find something that could help with that problem. In comes this liquid latex!

I ordered one in the hopes that it would help with keeping the skin around my nails clean while I'm doing those messy manicures. I cleaned out an empty nail polish bottle and filled it up with this liquid latex. Then I used the brush from the nail polish bottle to apply the liquid latex to the skin around my nails. I gave it a few minutes to dry then did my manicure. Once done with the manicure I used a little nail polish remover on a brush to make sure none of the latex was attached to the polish on my nail (don't want to ruin the manicure by pulling the polish on my nail off with the latex). Then, using tweezers, I pulled the latex off of each finger. For the most part it came off easily leaving clean up much easier with less to clean.

This was a lifesaver! I am very pleased with this liquid latex. The only thing I don't like about it is the smell, it's almost a fishy smell. It is very strong at first when applying. Once dried the smell does dissipate for the most part so it doesn't bother me that much.

For those who came here looking for it for your hair, as a deep conditioning you would want to apply it to dry hair and to the ends only, unless you have a dry scalp, then you can apply to your scalp. You can leave it in as long as you want, and wrap your hair in saran wrap for an even more intense conditioning. When you have a good idea of how much to use, you can do it on damp hair. Is it just me? I have purchased this exact product several times--happily--in dark brown, grey brown, and chestnut (red brown). My eyebrows are, like my natural hair, about a level 4 or 5 dark brown, and the grey brown is probably the closest, though the other colors are handy for changes of color to hair and makeup. My brows are thinning, but a little filling in does the trick, and these pens are my favorite tool for the job, as they both color in where you need solid filling and can be used to make feathery strokes for a more natural brow look. This pen came with a useless little razor and three eyebrow "templates," only one of which I might consider useful (if you are new to shaping your brows).
The problem:
In the past I have received (I see now from other sellers) at least two or three pens for $6.99 to $8.99. I can't believe I paid over $8 for just one pen from this seller "Generies." Going back over the seller page, I see that indeed, by the pictures it appears that one will receive two pens. A sneaky little trick, showing the same photos as the sellers with better deals, but neglecting to include the "2 CT." If you are busy or distracted in the least, you might fall for it, as did I--and doubtless, as have many customers.
I really dislike writing negative comments, but am doing this to save others the trouble and disappointment of feeling ripped off. Needless to say, I will be buying this product from other sellers in future--the ones with the more reasonable--and honest--deals.

This was my first experience with a wig that wasn’t from Spirit Halloween and I can’t say it was much better. After trying this wig I decided to learn a little more about wigs and I found a ton of info out there about them and how to do a little work on the less expensive ones to make them look better. (ie: thinning them out, plucking the part and hairline, etc.) I also learned about the features of a wig that make it look more realistic, such as synthetic vs human hair/human hair blend, pre-plucked and lace front. Now that I know a bit about wigs I feel more optimistic that I’ll be able to find ones that are affordable yet look more realistic and/or that I’ll be able to work on them a bit to make them look more so. In summary: The part and thickness on this wig are what I think need the most work. There’s virtually no part and the hair on the top is much too dense and puffy. This could be rectified by plucking but the wig is just not worth the work, IMO. The style of it is cute—The length and the waviness of it were exactly what I was looking for. I can’t say the same about the bangs but that’s the part of the wig that would benefit from some plucking and thinning out. The softness is pretty good for a synthetic wig.  I can’t comment on tangling because I didn’t keep the wig long enough to see how it holds up. The color is hard to comment on because it looks so different depending on the light—It can look like an ashy light brown with subtle highlights, a darker, less ashy light brown with no dimension to it, and in others it appears to have a mauve-like tinge to it. (You can see the differences in the pics.) In the end I returned this wig and after doing more research I decided I wouldn’t buy another inexpensive synthetic hair wig and instead look for a human hair blend that may be a little more expensive but looks more realistic. The bottom line: I recommend not buying this wig unless you know how to work on a wig to make it look more realistic.

Then I ran my hands through my hair, keeping the oil away from the scalp area.  Afterwards, I blew my hair dry then applied more oil.  Usually, I apply a gel in the same manner that calms the frizz and leaves my hair with a nice shine to it.  However, the oil did not produce the same results.  My hair still had flyaway ends with no gloss to it.  My newly washed and dried hair always looks better the next morning after the hair product has had a chance to calm the frizzy hair shafts, but the morning after I used the oil, the results were no different than the night before.

I’ll stick to my gel product to end the frizziness of dry hair.

I have used ionizing brushes for over 30 years—since they were first sold by Sharper Image. The negative ions work very well to flatten the surface of the cuticle of each hair, making the hair less likely to break or split, and also softer.

This particular brush works well, but the one I received has a minor design flaw: the brush part pops off so easily that I have to hold it tight with my thumb, making it less ergonomic than it might be... not an issue for me. Unlike some similar products, there are NO seams that could catch the hair.

TIPS FOR ALL IONIZING BRUSHES:
(1) if they don't need electricity (cord or batteries), they're not the real deal

This is a beautiful oil to treat yourself, but the bottle is misleading. If you look carefully, you can see that the liquid does not reach the bottom, that there is another glass bottom a ways up, making the bottle appear more full than it is. I took a star off for that because that's just not cool. They could make it in a smaller bottle & people would still pay $48 for it. It's a nice product. I wish, however, that it didn't have the olive oil in it, because that's what I think is causing acne in a lot of girls skin. For those with acne or if you just don't want to pay this much, you can get the same "velvet" results with rosehip oil. The Ordinary has one for 10 bucks. Rosehip oil can help reduce your inflammatory acne, get rid of acne scars, and clear your skin. Rosehip oil is an anti-inflammatory, able to reduce swelling and fluid buildup. Rosehip oil has a low rating of 1-2 on the comedogenic scale (a.k.a. not likely to clog dem pores). Plus, the linoleic fatty acids in rosehip oil have been shown to reduce oil production in oily skin types which can help prevent future acne. I received this Velvet Skin Drink as a sample & like others, I was impressed, but I found it for brand new & sealed for $24 on Mercari. Personally, because of the olive oil filler and the bottle deception, I wasn't willing to pay $48. They do some great marketing, evidently, as it's out of stock all the time. They make it sound like it's made of purely grapes, which it's not & the bottle deception just isn't worth the hype. Yes, the product is beautiful & makes your skin very soft, but is it softer than my Ordinary Rosehip oil? Nah. This is something nice to splurge on if I find a good deal, because of the of Sarantoni grapes, Resveratrol and lactic acid. But there are no studies on the benefits of these grapes over other grapes & they don't say how much Resvertal and lactic acid they use. I wouldn't consider this an active of any of those products. The Ordinary has both for cheap.

Hyaluronic Acid? I never knew what it was until recently :) sounds like something you use in the brakes on your car. hyaluronic acid (also known as hyaluronan) is a glycosaminoglycan, a type of molecule composed partly of sugars. Hyaluronic acid is actually a natural structural component of skin, and, in fact, is present in connective tissue throughout the human body.

The awesome thing about Hydrolic Acid is its ability to retain moisture; it’s considered to have a greater capacity to hold moisture than any other natural or synthetic polymer. In fact, one gram of hyaluronic acid is able to hold up to six liters of water. The hallmarks of youthful skin is its moisture content. A dried up face will age you quicker then anything.

Hyaluronic acid can improve your skin’s moisture content and at the same time strengthen skin’s barrier; that is, the outer layers of your skin. A healthy barrier looks and feels softer, smoother, and plumper. This does all of that. Sense menopause I have suffered from dry skin. This has made a big difference in how my face looks and feels. I purchased this product in a store, but I am such a fan I had to write a review. Ever since I purchased this palette, it has been my go-to for everyday makeup. I am fair-skinned with dark hair and hazel eyes, and the colors are perfect. I don't always use every color in a palette and I don't always place the colors as directed, but in this case, Stila knows what they are talking about!

The large color on the left is your all-over base, and I apply that first. Next, I go to the top right corner and apply this grayish color from crease to browbone. Third, I take the darkest color and place it quite heavily (but narrowly) in the crease and a little in the corner and lash line. Next, I put the highlight (lightest) color just under the brow and also outside the inner corner of the eye. Finally, I put the shimmery gold-like color in the middle across the lid and blend all the colors with a blending brush. I use the darker blush normally, but use the light one as a highlight if I want the added effect. I love that when I am doing my makeup on the run, I only have to grab this one container and my makeup brushes (I have the EcoTools Eye Enhancing Duo Brush set with four tips on two brushes, so even there you don't have to take as much with you).

The quality of the product is excellent and it blends well. Other than the darkest brown, the eyeshadow pigments are not super intense, so you can go light or apply more for a deeper intensity.

Since becoming a mom, I've been trying to live a greener, less toxic lifestyle.  I've started cloth diapering & using un-paper towels.  I've switched to natural body & laundry products.  However, for some reason, I had been holding out on switching to chemical free cleaning and fabric/air fresheners. I'm not exactly sure why I was so hesitant. These bottles made making the switch fun and easy!

These bottles have both a mist and a stream spray option, as well as an option to turn off the spraying mechanism.  Currently, I have one bottle filled with a 1:1 ratio of water to vinegar for use as glass cleaner.  The mist option works well on my mirrors and shower doors.  The mist option also works very well for both my homemade room/linen spray and my pest repellent spray. (Peppermint essential oil diluted with water and sprayed on the baseboards/around door and windows.)  I use the direct stream option for my tub and tile cleaner.  It works very well for spraying directly onto the grout.

At 16oz, the bottles are substantial but are not heavy in hand. The trigger is easy to squeeze, yet not flimsy.  The glass itself is a gorgeous, deep cobalt blue.  I keep my homemade air freshener in one of these bottles on the bathroom counter and have been asked multiple times about where I got it.  They really are just so very pretty.  Too pretty to be hidden under the sink like most other air freshener or cleaning supply bottles.

Often times, when you purchase cleaners from the store in inexpensive plastic bottles with these same mechanisms, the spray head tends to leak after a week or two of use. It never fails.  These, however, are sturdy and seem to be much more heavy duty.  I've used these bottles nearly daily and have not had any leaks whatsoever. As beautiful as these bottles are, this is what impressed me most. I'm extremely happy with this product and would highly recommend them!

I’ve been single-blade shaving for about 5 years. I enjoy trying out different blades and soaps. This is one of my stand-byes so I can recommend this soap.

1. SHAVE: EXCELLENT.  Mitchell’s is very slick and leaves very little tendency to cut or scrape. It results in a close, smooth shave in two passes. Most premium soaps result in a good-to-excellent shave.

2. SKIN: EXCELLENT. This product contains lanolin and results in the very best and softest after-shave experience of any soap I’ve tried.  Most premium soaps result in a fair-to-good experience for me.

3. VERSATILITY: GOOD. Some soaps seem to shave very well with one brand of blade and not others. Mitchell’s doesn’t seem to mind. I use ASTRA and generally sharp blades.

4. LATHER: FAIR. This soap deposits easily onto a wet badger brush, sufficient to lather onto the skin and shave well. It does not whip into a full thick lather if that is important to you. It is also reputed (I have no direct experience) to be difficult to lather at all if you have hard water.

5. LATHER DURABILITY: GOOD. The lather on the brush lasts OK during the shave. Easily enough for two passes.

6. PUCK DURABILITY: EXCELLENT.  I tend to rotate among several brands of soap, and most milled soaps collect enough water from the brush to decay and dry out somewhat before the puck is finished. Mitchell’s lasts to the end.

8. VALUE: FAIR. Mitchell’s is priced about the same as other premium milled soaps. However, if it is sold as a bare replacement puck so you will need a shaving bowel or other container.

The pictures show eyelashes that look solidly pink (or whatever colour you buy); mine did not come out like that. The brush tends to carry a lot of mascara so I got some clumping.
My eyelashes, which are black, ended up pinkish over the black near the base but with pink tips and I actually think it looks better than the professional pics. What's that saying about necessity being the mother of invention? Well here we are in a pandemic wearing face masks. Someone came up with the idea of a head band with buttons to hold the mask mask in place.

This is a thin material. Think very thin t shirt type material. The headband measures about 18 inches and just over 3 inches wide. I like the material for a headband. However, its use as a mask holder is iffy. Many people complain that the elastic that holds the masks in place makes their ears pop out. That is definitely true of some masks. They can also be wearying on the ears, having that elastic against your ears all day, so this headband is a great concept.
I put the headband on and as I stretched it over my head, I heard a pop, so some stitching gave somewhere.

One mask using the buttons fit well. Another did not. The latter mask opened up on the sides.

I would hesitate to wear this out thinking that everything would stay put for hours. I like the headband as a headband. It's nice material. A sort of light grey merle, but if you are looking at this for long-term safety, I would say no.

I’ve had numerous extensions in my life. I bought these as a cheaper alternative to the Bellami volumizing weft, which is expensive (definitely an investment). I have fine hair but a lot of it. The problem I have with many extension companies is blending the extensions with my own hair, since most of them are so thin my hair peaks through. I also have shoulder length hair, which adds another level of difficulty when trying to blend extensions.

Pros
• The hair is soft
• The hair doesn’t tangle easily
• The color is nice
• The clips are amazing. Once I clip them in they stay.
• They are convenient. One weft and you’re done (usually)
• They are cheap, and a good quality for the price
• Good starting off extensions

Cons
• The hair is thin; it is heavier on top and thins out to a v-point. As expected my hair peaked though. I ended up tying up my bottom layer and  putting the extensions on top. It solved the problem of the hair poking though.
• For these extensions to work for me I would need to buy at least two more packs of hair. Having 3, five clip wefts wouldn’t fit around my head comfortably.
• These will not give you volume; they are too thin to give you any thickness
• If you have a lot of hair these will not look very natural

This hair is best suited for someone with thin, medium length hair who is looking for some length. Also, if you have layers in your hair it could help blend the hair. I got my own hair thinned out a little at the hair salon and it made a huge difference.

This hair will not work well with short hair or thick hair unless you are willing to work hard to blend it.

I will be buying one more weft in order to see how that works out for me. I will update this post once I receive my new weft.

I have relatively long (just past my bust line) hair with long layers - the trick to getting all of the end pieces of the layers to stay tucked in place is to pull the bun maker down the length of your ponytail just before you reach the end of the shortest layer. Then, fold all of the rest of the ends upward over the hair piece and tuck them inward towards the center of the ponytail. As you roll the hair piece upwards, continue to tuck any loose ends in so that they are held in place by the rolled hair. The other trick to getting a perfectly round bun is that once you have rolled the hair piece all the way up with your hair, fold the ends inward towards each other to form a circle, but make sure to tighten this circle as much as possible by pushing the ends as close together as you can. Otherwise, these hair pieces are fairly self-explanatory to use, and there are step-by-step instructions included with each of the four bun maker pieces. In addition to these four pieces, this product also includes 2 sets of 8 bobby pins -- 1 set is about 2" long each and the other set is about 3" long.

Any reviews stating this wand does not give curl either has too short of hair, isn't using a high enough heat setting, or is completely doing it wrong. Ok sooo I don’t know about this one. Clear vitamin C means it is 100% potent, but having an ingredient list that potency is no longer 100%. So upon seeing clear thick serum I was skeptical. Soon as I opened the bottle I added several drops to a small old bottle I own and left it open exposing to air, lights and anything else that causes oxidizing to the vitamin c. It stayed clear. After one week straight no changes. I even popped into the microwave for 8 seconds still clear. Had it contained ferulic acid I would have been less skeptic because FA is a Vitamin C stabilizer. On its own Vitamin C (L-absorbic acid) is unstable and begins to oxidize once the seal is broken. Yes even pure vitamin C in water it will turn a slight yellow and begin to darken.

But my skin did not break out a good thing. Even if it doesn’t contain vitamin c the other ingredients are a plus especially glycerin as the second ingredient ... which is a natural humectant, anti microbial and antiviral all meaning moisturized skin that won’t get clogged and controls acne. I do get acne (thank the skin gurus) but I do chemical exfoliate with acids and use a retinol. Two things that cause dry skin. If I should break out from a product then it is pure trash and the PH is way off.

So it has it pluses and minuses.

As someone with very sensitive skin, I have always had problems with razor burn after shaving. Dry electric shavers tend to butcher my skin.  Traditional multi-blade razors (like the Mach 3) are easier on my skin, but as sensitive as my skin is, cuts are not uncommon.  A few months ago I received a Norelco 7735X Cool Skin Additive In/Out of Shower Shaver as a gift and gave it a try.  Thanks to the shaving gel that can be applied to the skin at the touch of a button while shaving, it provides a very close shave that doesn't cut my skin like a traditional razor, and there's very little skin irritation afterwards.  As for closeness, I'd say that it's almost as good as a Mach 3 razor.

One aspect about this shaver that I like is that it operates from a rechargeable battery so that there's no electric cord to get in the way while shaving.  Also, the shaving gel packets are easy to replace, it comes with a charger stand, it's easy to clean the rotating blades and it takes up little bathroom counter space.  Further, it takes less time to shave and clean-up afterwards than with a traditional razor & shaving cream.

Overall, I regard the Norelco 7735X Cool Skin Additive In/Out of Shower Shaver as a very good shaver and rate it with 5 out of 5 stars.  Granted, it is somewhat expensive, but if you have very sensitive skin like me, you might be as pleasantly surprised as I was with its performance.

This is the latest shaver in Norelco's Quadra system.  The shaving heads are mounted in such a way that gives them the freedom to depress independently of one another, to better adapt to the unique contours of your face.  Another advantage to this razor is that the shaving heads can be washed under the faucet.  This is a feature that the Quadra system razors share with the more expensive Spectra system razors.
This razor is light-years better than my previous Norelco.  My last Norelco was the 885, bought back in 1991.  That razor always irritated my skin, especially the neck area.  Although it did last nine years.  Three years ago, I switched to the Braun Syncro system.  The Braun worked very well for me.  Anyway, I decided to give Norelco another try.  I was very surprised, and impressed, to say the least.  This Quadra shaves just as close and just as comfortable as the Braun Syncro.  And, it is very quiet.  So far, I am only getting 35 minutes of shaving time per charge.  But, I believe that the battery will reach its full capacity after a few more discharge and charge cycles.
For me, it is an even choice between this Norelco and the Braun.  I can readily recommend either one.  I suppose you just might have to try both and see which one will work better for you.  One thing is obvious though.  Either one will save you money in the long run, compared to using a blade shaver like the Mach 3, for example.  The long-term cost of periodically buying replacement blades for a Mach 3 or Sensor Excel can easily exceed the price of either one of the electrics.  I will admit, however, that neither of the electric razors can match the closeness of the Mach 3.

I recently started using one of these with loofa on it. It works for me, even if loofa does take a while to break in. However, it also absorbs quite a bit of soap. I like this one much better.

Instead of spreading it all over the thing - I like the side with little bristles like a brush - all you need is to put some in the center. Moving the brush over your back spreads the soap out nicely and does the job without a lot of waste. It squeaks a bit on un-soaped skin, but that's pretty easy to get over and doesn't last long. It was just a surprise, initially. It feels like a gentle scrub, and that's the important part. It also rinses off easily and dries quickly, an important point here in our humid climate. The interior relative humidity in our house hovers around 55% in the summer, so things can get moldy fast. That's what usually happens if a loofa or any other kind of absorbent surface isn't dried properly. I just hang this up on the thoughtfully provided suction hooks and forget about it. It's great, and I'm really glad I gave this a try!

It's advertised as a no heat hair curler clips but for me it did not work without heat.  Using without heat resulted in kinks.  NEVER use on wet hair or the kinks will be set in your hair until you wash and restyle.  These clips are not a replacement for double prong root clips used in the curly girl method.  I watched every video I could find on how to use these clips and they all used the following steps:  (1) Start with clean dry hair.  Move the top layer of hair out of the way and take a section of hair from underneath.  Put the clips in with some looseness against the scalp.  They should not be tight against your scalp.  Make sure the clip part is turned to the outside and the hair is pulled straight away from scalp.  (2) apply heat gently to hair using medium to high heat and low air flow (3) apply cold air using hair dryer or wait for hair to cool naturally.  Do not leave the clip in too long if you are letting it cool naturally or it may leave kinks.  (3) Take out the clips and comb through with fingers, ruffling slightly to break up any visible kinks.  Blend in top layer so any kinks still visible will be hidden underneath.  Good luck!

The Maybuy Professional Hair Clippers/Beard Trimmers comes with 3 attachments, 1/2 inch, 1 inch and 1.5 inches.  These attachments simply clip onto the head of the trimmer.  You also get a small brush for cleaning the trimmer and a charging cable which strangely is a USB to Mini-USB even though at the bottom of the trimmer is your standard two prong charging connector.

Being able to charge this via USB however is great for when you need to go on holiday/vacation as you always have some kind of USB charging device with yourself (usually for your phone).  On a full charge the clippers will roughly 2 hours and are small enough to just throw in your toiletry bag.

The trimmer itself has a nice shape to it and is comfortable to hold in your hand.  It also has a fairly nice heft to it, not too light but not heavy.  It feels like you are really holding on to something though.

The head is fairly wide which can be a plus in that it doesn't take long at all to trim an area but can also be a bit of a minus depending on the shape of your face if you are trimming your beard.  The action is smooth and has a nice gliding feel to it, even if you don't use any attachments and just use the trimmer head itself.

It would have been nice if the Maybuy came with some sort of carrying case to put it, the attachments and the charging cord in but it doesn't unfortunately. The attachments do come in a small Ziploc bag.

Overall a nice trimmer, nice action and makes quick work whether trimming your beard or hard to reach places like around your ears.

I was shopping for replacement cutters and combs for a Norelco Micro Action (formerly Lift & Cut [formerly Rotatract]) shaver and noticed that for less than $10 more I could have a whole new  Norelco shaver. I was sold.

Norelco Reflex Plus shavers combine 4 features pioneered by Norelco and improved over time. Rotary heads reduce the vibration common to reciprocating shavers. Floating heads individually hug the skin. Lift and Cut blades gently pull whiskers into the cutter for a closer shave. Everything rides on a set of pivoting platforms that bulge slightly at the center of the head assembly.  The bulge allows the heads to maintain contact with the contours of difficult to shave spots like the concave hollows of the neck below the chin.

I've been a Norelco man from my first crop of peachfuzz to my current orchard of gray quills, so the first shave wasn't a surprise for my skin. It was as close and comfy as I'd expect from a Norelco.

The real revelation was the sound. The previous Lift and Cut was like shaving with a Black & Decker DustBuster. The Reflex Plus is so quiet, you can actually hear the cutters slice off the whiskers and then fall silent on the next pass over the same area. This is a real help for those times when a mirror isn't nearby. You could actually shave by the sound alone!

A somewhat poignant note: Models at the economy end of the Norelco line are now made in China and lack carrying bags of any kind. When I travel, I roll my shaver in an article of clothing, usually a T-shirt, so the carrying case is no biggie. Still, I miss seeing the words "MADE IN HOLLAND" on the bottom of every Norelco I've owned.

Times may change but at least the quality of the shave has only improved.

Let me start by saying, I did NOT order this from Amazon.  I ordered it from Sephora.  The reviews here regarding whether this product was a fake or not made me a little leery.  So, I'm reviewing the real Josie Maran Vibrancy foundation and not the Amazon version, real or not.

As usual, I ordered the lightest shade, RG5.  It's a nearly perfect match.  It's described as being for fair skin with neutral undertones.  I typically prefer foundations with pink undertones, but this actually worked really well for me.

The consistency is on the thin, runny side, which isn't surprising since oil is an ingredient.  Having said that, this foundation sits on the skin so beautifully.  It looks like real skin.  It's definitely not a matte foundation, so if that's your preference, this is not the foundation for you.  This foundation gives you more luminous, dewy-looking skin.  I don't typically care for dewy foundations, but again, I was surprised to like this one.  It just made my skin look healthy and plump.  It didn't look at all heavy, which is great because it didn't settle into my fine lines.  I did notice it took a while to set.  Again, not surprising considering the oil content, but you'll want to make sure you set it with powder before trying to blend blush/contour/bronzer, etc.  Otherwise, you'll likely look pretty streaky.

Many reviewers here have mentioned a smell.  I didn't notice that at all, which is another reason I think the product people are buying here might not be legit.

The only reason I gave this 4 stars instead of 5 is because my t-zone gets oily fairly quickly while wearing it.

I'd recommend this for more mature skin and dry skin types.  If you're oily, you can definitely still wear it, you just might have to blot a bit more than usual.

Overall, though, a great foundation.  Just make sure it's what you're looking for.  It's a very specific look.

I usually get about 3 flosses in before having to refill the water reservoir (which is very simple). This one does come with several tips so I tried them all after settling on one. I think having several different options is nice so that you can find the pressure and kind of tip that works best for you and meets your own unique needs. Overall, I think this water flosser is great. It does exactly what I need it to do and I got it for a fraction of the price from the dentists office. I would confidently recommend it to others! Love being able to access electrolysis at home!  I have been going to a professional for months now and when the 2020 pandemic began and all service providers closed up shop,  I wasn't sure how I would deal with unwanted facial hair.  Where other methods of hair removal can encourage stronger hair regrowth I did not want to regress.  Then I found this!  I have had this product several weeks now and am very happy with it.  I wish I had found this earlier.  Not only can I do a treatment whenever I want, I am able to target hairs when they first appear as opposed to waiting for an appointment.  It is very easy to use.  I was afraid I would be unable to target the follicle in the right spot but that has not been a problem.  It has a high pitch buzz when the current is delivered to the follicle.  Most of the time the sound is my only indication that anything is happening.  I do not find this painful.  I can tell it is working because when I go to remove the hair it comes out with no effort.  I do keep the power at the highest setting except for the delicate area above the upper lip.  That can be a painful area at home or at the salon.

My only complaint with the product is that the tweezers included are useless.  Just use your own.
I bent the stylist at first so I did order extras to have in case that happens again... so far so good as I haven't ruined another.  I don't think that is a product flaw as it must be very delicate to do the job right... just be careful.

If you are unfamiliar with electrolysis, do not expect that one shot will forever kill a hair.  I suggest reading articles on the subject as this can be a long term process.  But considering other methods are a FOREVER process... go for it !
